query: देहिनोऽस्मिन्यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा |तथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिर्धीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति |
positive: Just as boyhood, youth and old age are attributed to the soul through this body, even so it attains another body. The wise man does not get deluded about this.
negative: Having subdued his mind and body, and given up all objects of enjoyment, and free from craving; he who performs sheer bodily actions, does not incur sin.

query: यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ |समदुःखसुखं धीरं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते |
positive: Arjuna, the wise man to whom pain and pleasure are the same, who is not disturbed by the contacts of the senses and their objects, is fit for immortality.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः |उभयोरपि दृष्टोऽन्तस्त्वनयोस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः |
positive: The unreal has no existence, and the real never ceases to be, the reality of both has thus been perceived by the seers of truth.
negative: He who sees Mepresent in all beings, and all beings existing within Me, never loses sight of Me, and I never lose sight of him.

query: अन्तवन्त इमे देहा नित्यस्योक्ताः शरीरिणः |अनाशिनोऽप्रमेयस्य तस्माद्युध्यस्व भारत |
positive: Know that alone to be imperishable, which pervades this universe; for no one has power to destroy this indestructible substance.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम् |उभौ तौ न विजानीतो नायं हन्ति न हन्यते |
positive: All these bodies pertaining to the imperishable, indefinable and eternal soul are spoken of as perishable; therefore, Arjuna, fight.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः |अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणोन हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे |
positive: The soul is never born nor dies; nor does it become only after being born. For it is unborn, eternal, everlasting and ancient; even though the body is slain, the soul is not.
negative: Arjuna, this soul dwelling in the bodies of all can never be slain; therefore, you should not mourn for anyone.

query: वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनमजमव्ययम् |कथं स पुरुषः पार्थ कं घातयति हन्ति कम् |
positive: Arjuna, the man who knows this soul to be imperishable, eternal and free from birth and decay,—how and whom will he cause to be killed, how and whom will he kill?
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहायनवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि |तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णा-न्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही |
positive: As a man shedding worn-out garments, takes other new ones, likewise the embodied soul, casting off worn-out bodies, enters into others which are new.
negative: Having attained the worlds of the righteous, the virtuous dwell there for a long time, and then the fallen yogi is born again in the house of the pure and prosperous.

query: नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः |न चैनं क्लेदयन्त्यापो न शोषयति मारुतः |
positive: Weapons cannot cut it, nor can fire burn it; water cannot wet it nor can wind dry it.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: अच्छेद्योऽयमदाह्योऽयमक्लेद्योऽशोष्य एव च |नित्यः सर्वगतः स्थाणुरचलोऽयं सनातनः |
positive: For this soul is incapable of being cut; it is proof against fire, impervious to water and undriable as well. This soul is eternal, omnipresent, immovable, constant and everlasting.
negative: Having restrained all the senses, even-minded everywhere, intent on the welfare of all beings verily they also come unto Me

query: अव्यक्तोऽयमचिन्त्योऽयमविकार्योऽयमुच्यते |तस्मादेवं विदित्वैनं नानुशोचितुमर्हसि |
positive: This soul is unmanifest; it is unthinkable; and it is spoken of as immutable. Therefore, knowing this as such, you should not grieve.
negative: He, however, who takes delight in the self alone and is gratified with the Self, and is contented in the self, has no duty.

query: अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम् |तथापि त्वं महाबाहो नैवं शोचितुमर्हसि |
positive: And, Arjuna, if you should suppose this soul to be subject to constant birth and death, even than you should not grieve like this.Hardly anyone perceives this soul as marvellous, scarce another likewise speaks thereof as marvellous, and scarce another hears of it as marvellous; while there are some who know it not even on hearing of it.
negative: Arjuna, this soul dwelling in the bodies of all can never be slain; therefore, you should not mourn for anyone.

query: जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च |तस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि |
positive: For in that case death is certain for the born, and rebirth is inevitable for the dead. You should not, therefore, grieve over the inevitable.
negative: Arjuna, this soul dwelling in the bodies of all can never be slain; therefore, you should not mourn for anyone.

query: अव्यक्तादीनि भूतानि व्यक्तमध्यानि भारत |अव्यक्तनिधनान्येव तत्र का परिदेवना |
positive: Arjuna, before birth beings are not manifest to our human senses; at death they return to the unmanifest. What is there to grieve about in such a state?
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्चिदेन-माश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्यः |आश्चर्यवच्चैनमन्यः शृणोतिश्रुत्वाप्येनं वेद न चैव कश्चित् |
positive: Hardly anyone perceives this soul as marvellous, scarce another likewise speaks thereof as marvellous, and scarce another hears of it as marvellous; while there are some who know it not even on hearing of it.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: देही नित्यमवध्योऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत |तस्मात्सर्वाणि भूतानि न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि |
positive: Arjuna, this soul dwelling in the bodies of all can never be slain; therefore, you should not mourn for anyone.
negative: He who sees Mepresent in all beings, and all beings existing within Me, never loses sight of Me, and I never lose sight of him.

query: स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि |धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाच्छ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते |
positive: Besides: considering your own duty too you should not waver; for there is nothing superior for a warrior than a righteous war.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम् |सुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम् |
positive: Arjuna, happy are the Ksatriyas who get such an unsolicited opportunity for war; which opens the door to heaven.
negative: Die, and you will win heaven; conquer, and you enjoy sovereignty of the earth; therefore, stand up, Arjuna, determined to fight.

query: अथ चेत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि |ततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापमवाप्स्यसि |
positive: Now, if you refuse to fight this righteous war, then, shirking your duty and losing your reputation, you will incur sin.
negative: Since I have no craving for the fruit of actions; actions do not contaminate Me, Even he who thus knows Me in reality is not bound by actions.

query: अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति तेऽव्ययाम् |सम्भावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते |
positive: Nay, people will also pour undying infamy on you; and infamy brought on a man enjoying popular esteem is worse than death.
negative: Even the wise call him a sage, whose undertaking are all free from desire and thoughts of the world, and whose actions are burnt up by the fire of wisdom.

query: हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम् |तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः |
positive: Die, and you will win heaven; conquer, and you enjoy sovereignty of the earth; therefore, stand up, Arjuna, determined to fight.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ |ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि |
positive: Treating alike victory and defeat, gain and loss, pleasure and pain, get ready for the fight, then; fighting thus you will not incur sin.
negative: Arjuna, happy are the Ksatriyas who get such an unsolicited opportunity for war; which opens the door to heaven.

query: एषा तेऽभिहिता साङ्ख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां शृणु |बुद्ध्या युक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि |
positive: Arjuna, this attitude of mind has been declared to you in the knowledge yoga; now hear it in the karma yoga by which, being united with wisdom, you will thoroughly destroy the bondage of actions.
negative: Know also, O best among the twice-born! the names of those who are the most distinguished amongst ourselves, the leaders of my army; these I name to thee for thy information.

query: व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन |बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम् |
positive: Arjuna, in this Yogathe intellect is determinate and directed singly towards one ideal; whereas the intellect of the undecidedwanders in all directions, after innumerable aims.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: यामिमां पुष्पितां वाचं प्रवदन्त्यविपश्चितः |वेदवादरताः पार्थ नान्यदस्तीति वादिनः |
positive: Arjuna, those unwise ones who are devoted to the letter of the Vedas and argue that there is nothing beyond heaven, utter flowery speech.
negative: He who, offering the highest love to Me, preaches the most profound gospel of the gita among my devotees, shall come to me alone, there is no doubt about it.

query: कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा जन्मकर्मफलप्रदाम् |क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति |
positive: Those who are full of desires, whose goal is heaven, who cling to rebirth and the fruits of action, who delight in various ritualistic works aimed at enjoyment and power.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: त्रैगुण्यविषया वेदा निस्त्रैगुण्यो भवार्जुन |निर्द्वन्द्वो नित्यसत्त्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान् |
positive: Arjuna, the Vedas thus deal with evolutes of the three Gunas; viz., worldly enjoyments and the means of attaining such enjoyments; be thou indifferent to these enjoyments and their means, rising above pairs of opposites like pleasure and pain etc., established in the Eternal Existence, absolutely unconcerned about the supply of wants and the preservation of what has been already attained, and self-controlled.
negative: He who is indifferent to honour and ignominy; is alike to the cause of a friend as well as to that of an enemy, and has renounced the senses of doership in all undertakings, is said to have risen above the three Gunas.

query: यावानर्थ उदपाने सर्वतः सम्प्लुतोदके |तावान्सर्वेषु वेदेषु ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः |
positive: A Brahmana, who has obtained enlightenment, has the same use for all the Vedas as one who stands at the brink of a sheet of water overflowing on all sides has for a small reservoir of water.
negative: They who, having taken refuge in Me, strive for deliverance from old age and death know Brahma, the whole Adhyatma, and the entire field of Karma.

query: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय |सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते |
positive: Arjuna, perform your duties established in Yoga, renouncing attachment, and even-tempered in success and failure; evenness of temper is called Yoga.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगाद्धनञ्जय |बुद्धौ शरणमन्विच्छ कृपणाः फलहेतवः |
positive: Far inferior is action performed with attachment, O Dhananjaya, compared with the yoga of wisdom. The wise seek refuge in wisdom, renouncing the fruits of action, for the ignorant are attached to the fruits.
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः |जन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम् |
positive: For wise men possessing an equipo­sied mind, renouncing the fruit of actions and freed from the shackles of birth, attain the blissful supreme state.
negative: Even the wise call him a sage, whose undertaking are all free from desire and thoughts of the world, and whose actions are burnt up by the fire of wisdom.

query: यदा ते मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति |तदा गन्तासि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च |
positive: When your mind will have fully crossed the more of delusion, you will then grow indifferent to the enjoyments of this world.
negative: They, however, who, finding fault with this teaching of Mine, do not follow it, take those fools to be deluded in the matter of all knowledge, and lost.

query: अर्जुन उवाच |स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव |स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम् |
positive: Arjuna said: O Keshava, what is the description of a man of steady wisdom, who is established in Samadhi? What does he do at dawn, what in the evening, and what at night? Arjuna said: Krishna, what is the definitionof a God-realized soul, stable to mind and established in Samadhi? How does the man of stable mind speak, how does he sit, how does he walk?
negative: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, hear once again My supreme word, which I shall speak to you, who are so loving, out of solicitude for your welfare.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |प्रजहाति यदा कामान्सर्वान्पार्थ मनोगतान् |आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते |
positive: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, when one thoroughly dismisses all cravings of the mind, and is satisfied in the self throughthe self, then he is called stable of mind.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः |वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते |
positive: The sage, whose mind remains unperturbed amid sorrows, whose thirst for pleasure has altogether disappeared, and who is free from passion, fear and anger, is called stale of mind.
negative: He who is able to endure the force of desire and anger born of the mind before the destruction of the body, he is a yogi and he is happy.

query: यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत्तत्प्राप्य शुभाशुभम् |नाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता |
positive: He who is unattached to everything, and meeting with good and evil, neither rejoices nor recoils, his mind is stable.
negative: He who has given up all desires, and moves free from attachment, egoism and thirst for enjoyment attains peace.

query: यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः |इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता |
positive: When like a tortoise, which draws in its limbs from all directions, he withdraws his senses from the sense-objects, his mind isstable.
negative: Therefore, Arjuna, he whose senses are restrained in all respects from their objects, his intelligence is firmly established.

query: विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः |रसवर्जं रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते |
positive: Objects of the senses turn away from the abstinent embodied soul; having tasted the sweetness of the sense-objects, he turns away from them.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः |वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता |
positive: Having restrained all the senses, he should sit with his mind fixed on Me, devoted and controlling his senses; for the man who has his senses under control, his wisdom is firmly established.
negative: Therefore, Arjuna, he whose senses are restrained in all respects from their objects, his intelligence is firmly established.

query: ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते |सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते |
positive: The man dwelling on sense-objects develops attachment for them; from attachment springs up desire, and from desireensues anger.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: क्रोधाद्भवति सम्मोहः सम्मोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः |स्मृतिभ्रंशाद् बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति |
positive: From anger arises delusion; from delusion, loss of memory; from loss of memory, the destruction of intelligence; and when intelligence is destroyed, one falls down again into the material pool.
negative: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, you grieve over those who should not be grieved for, and yet speak like the learned; wise men do not sorrow over the dead or the living.

query: रागद्वेषविमुक्तैस्तु विषयानिन्द्रियैश्चरन् | (or वियुक्तैस्तु)आत्मवश्यैर्विधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति |
positive: But the self-controlled practicant, while enjoying the various sense-objects through his senses, which are disciplined and free from likes and dislikes, attains placidity of mind.
negative: He who is able to endure the force of desire and anger born of the mind before the destruction of the body, he is a yogi and he is happy.

query: प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिरस्योपजायते |प्रसन्नचेतसो ह्याशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते |
positive: With the attainment of such placidity of mind, all his sorrows come to an end; and the intellect of such a person of tranquil mind, soon withdrawing itself from all sides, becomes firmly established in God.
negative: Even the wise call him a sage, whose undertaking are all free from desire and thoughts of the world, and whose actions are burnt up by the fire of wisdom.

query: नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना |न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम् |
positive: He who has not controlled his mind and senses can have no reason; nor can such an undisciplined man think of God. the unthinking man can have no peace; and how That which is night to all beings, in that statethe God-realized Yogi keeps awake. And thatin which all beings keep awake is night to the seer.
negative: He who is unattached to everything, and meeting with good and evil, neither rejoices nor recoils, his mind is stable.

query: इन्द्रियाणां हि चरतां यन्मनोऽनुविधीयते |तदस्य हरति प्रज्ञां वायुर्नावमिवाम्भसि |
positive: As the wind carries away a boat upon the waters, even so of the senses moving among sense-objects, the one to which the mind is joined takes away his discrimination.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: तस्माद्यस्य महाबाहो निगृहीतानि सर्वशः |इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता |
positive: Therefore, Arjuna, he whose senses are restrained in all respects from their objects, his intelligence is firmly established.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी |यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः |
positive: That which is night to all beings, in that statethe God-realized Yogi keeps awake. And thatin which all beings keep awake is night to the seer.
negative: Therefore, Arjuna, he whose senses are restrained in all respects from their objects, his intelligence is firmly established.

query: विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः |निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः स शान्तिमधिगच्छति |
positive: He who has given up all desires, and moves free from attachment, egoism and thirst for enjoyment attains peace.
negative: He who is unattached to everything, and meeting with good and evil, neither rejoices nor recoils, his mind is stable.

query: एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति |स्थित्वास्यामन्तकालेऽपि ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृच्छति |
positive: Arjuna, such is the state of the God-realized soul; having reached this state, he overcomes delusion. And established in this state, even at the last moment, he attains Brahmic Bliss.
negative: One who, having obtained the beloved, does not rejoice, and having obtained the unlovely, is not disturbed; that steady-minded, unbewildered knower of Brahman is ever established in the One Supreme Spirit.

query: व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे |तदेकं वद निश्चित्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम् |
positive: You are, as it were, puzzling my mind by these seemingly involved expressions; therefore, tell me definitely the one discipline by which I may obtain the highest good.
negative: Thus the truth of the Ksetra and knowledge, as well as of the object worth knowing, God has been briefly discussed; knowing this in reality, My devotee enters into My Being.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |लोकेऽस्मिन् द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ |ज्ञानयोगेन साङ्ख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम् |
positive: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, in this world there are two kinds of disciplines, as I have explained before: the discipline of the Sankhyas is by knowledge, and the discipline of the Yogis is by action.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते |न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति |
positive: Man does not attain freedom from actionwithout entering upon action; nor does he reach perfectionmerely by ceasing to act.
negative: God determines not the doership nor the doings of men, nor even their contact with the fruit of actions; but it is Nature alone that functions.

query: न हि कश्चित्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत् |कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः |
positive: Surely none can ever remain inactive even for a moment; for everyone helplessly driven to action by nature-born qualities.
negative: In this world that great soul has no use whatsoever for things done nor for things not done; nor has he selfish dependence of any kind on any creature.

query: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन् |इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते |
positive: He who outwardly restraining the organs of sense and action, sits mentally dwelling on the objects of senses, that man of deluded intellect is called a hypocrite.
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन |कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते |
positive: On the other hand, he who controlling the organs of sense and action by the power of his will, and remaining unattached, undertakes the Yoga of Action through those organs, Arjuna, he excels.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः |शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः |
positive: Therefore, do you perform your allotted duty, because action is indeed better than inaction; and even the maintenance of your body would not be possible without action.
negative: Having subdued his mind and body, and given up all objects of enjoyment, and free from craving; he who performs sheer bodily actions, does not incur sin.

query: यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः |तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसङ्गः समाचर |
positive: Man is bound by his own action except when it is performed for the sake of sacrifice. Therefore, Arjuna, do you efficiently perform your duty, free from attachment; for the sake of sacrifice alone.
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः |अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक् |
positive: Having created mankind together with sacrifices, the Lord of creatures said: By this shall the creatures prosper; let the sacrifice be duly performed. Having created mankind along with the spirit of sacrifice at the beginning of Creation the Creator, Brahma, said to them, “You shall prosper by this; may this yield the enjoyment you seek.”
negative: O creator of beings, O Ruler of creatures, O God of gods, the Lord of the universe, O supreme Purusha, You alone know what You are by Yourself.

query: देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः |परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ |
positive: Foster the gods through this, and let the gods be gracious to you. Each fostering other disinterestedly, you will attain the highest good.
negative: But the results of their worship are limited and perishable; those who worship the gods go to the gods, but My devotees ultimately come to Me.

query: इष्टान्भोगान्हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः |तैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः |
positive: Fostered by sacrifice, the gods will surely bestow on you unasked all the desired enjoyments. He who enjoys the gifts bestowed by them, without giving them in return, is undoubtedly a thief.
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः |भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात् |
positive: The men who eat the remnants of sacrifices are freed from all sins; but those who cook food only for their own body’s nourishment eat sin.
negative: Even though you were the foulest of all sinners, this Knowledge alone would carry you, like a raft, across all your sin.

query: अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः |यज्ञाद्भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः |
positive: All beings are evolved from food; production of food is dependent on rain; rain ensues from sacrifice.
negative: He who is able to endure the force of desire and anger born of the mind before the destruction of the body, he is a yogi and he is happy.

query: कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम् |तस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम् |
positive: And sacrifice is rooted in prescribed action. Know that prescribed action has its origin in the Vedas, and the Vedas proceed from the Indestructible; hence the all-pervading supreme imperishable Spirit is always established in sacrifice.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः |अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति |
positive: Arjuna, he who does not follow the wheel of creation thus set going in this world, sinful and sensual, he lives in vain.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च मानवः |आत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते |
positive: He, however, who takes delight in the self alone and is gratified with the Self, and is contented in the self, has no duty.
negative: In this world that great soul has no use whatsoever for things done nor for things not done; nor has he selfish dependence of any kind on any creature.

query: नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन |न चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्चिदर्थव्यपाश्रयः |
positive: In this world that great soul has no use whatsoever for things done nor for things not done; nor has he selfish dependence of any kind on any creature.
negative: Having subdued his mind and body, and given up all objects of enjoyment, and free from craving; he who performs sheer bodily actions, does not incur sin.

query: तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर |असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः |
positive: Therefore, go on efficiently doing your duty without attachment. Doing work without attachment man attains the Supreme.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः |लोकसंग्रहमेवापि सम्पश्यन्कर्तुमर्हसि |
positive: It is through actionalone that Janaka and otherwise men reached perfection. Having an eye to maintenance of the world order too you should take to action.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः |स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते |
positive: For whatever a great man does, that very thing other men also do; whatever standard he sets up; the generality of men follow the same.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः |मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः |
positive: Should I not engage in action, scrupulously at any time, great harm will come to the world; for, Arjuna, men follow My way in all matters.
negative: If You are unequal even to the pursuit of such practice, be intent to work for Me; you shall attain perfectioneven by performing actions for My sake.

query: सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत |कुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्चिकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम् |
positive: Arjuna, as the unwise act with attachment, so should the wise man, seeking maintenance of the world order, act without attachment.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम् |जोषयेत्सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान्युक्तः समाचरन् |
positive: A wise man established in the Self, should not unsettle the mind of the ignorant attached to action, but should perform all prescribed duties properly and also make others do the same.
negative: They, however, who, finding fault with this teaching of Mine, do not follow it, take those fools to be deluded in the matter of all knowledge, and lost.

query: तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो गुणकर्मविभागयोः |गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते |
positive: But, O mighty-armed, the knower of the truth about the division of the modes and the division of actions does not become attached, understanding that the modes are active within the modes.He, however, who has true insight into the respective spheres of Gunasand their actions, holding that it is the Gunasthat move among the Gunas, does not get attached to them, Arjuna.
negative: In this world that great soul has no use whatsoever for things done nor for things not done; nor has he selfish dependence of any kind on any creature.

query: प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु |तानकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत् |
positive: Those who are completely deluded by the Gunasof Prakrti remain attached to those Gunas and actions; the man of perfect Knowledge should not unsettle the mind of those insufficiently knowing fools.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा |निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः |
positive: Therefore, dedicating all actions to Me with your mind fixed on Me, the Self of all freed from hope and the feeling of meum and cured of mental fever, fight.
negative: Arjuna, during the Final Dissolution all beings enter My Prakrti, and at the beginning of creation, I send them forth again.

query: ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः |श्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः |
positive: Even those men who, with an uncavilling and devout mind, always follow this teaching of Mine are released from the bondage of all actions.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: ये त्वेतदभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम् |सर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्विद्धि नष्टानचेतसः |
positive: They, however, who, finding fault with this teaching of Mine, do not follow it, take those fools to be deluded in the matter of all knowledge, and lost.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि |प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति |
positive: All living creatures follow their tendencies; even the wise man acts according to the nature he has acquired. What can stubbornness do?
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ |तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ |
positive: Attraction and repulsion are rooted in all sense-objects. Man should never allow himself to be swayed by them, because they are the two principal enemies standing in the way of his redemption.
negative: Therefore, Arjuna, he whose senses are restrained in all respects from their objects, his intelligence is firmly established.

query: अर्जुन उवाच |अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः |अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः |
positive: Arjuna said: Now impelled by what, Krishna, does this man commit sin even involuntarily, as though driven by force?
negative: Arjuna, he who does not follow the wheel of creation thus set going in this world, sinful and sensual, he lives in vain.

query: धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथादर्शो मलेन च |यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम् |
positive: As fire is covered by smoke, and a mirror by dust, and the embryo is covered by the womb, so is knowledge covered by desire. As a flame is covered by smoke, mirror by dirt, and embryo by the amnion, so is Knowledge covered by it.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा |कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च |
positive: And, Arjuna, Knowledge stand covered by this eternal enemy of the wise, known as desire, which is insatiable like fire.
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना |जहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम् |
positive: Thus, Arjuna, knowing that which is higher than the intellect and subduing the mind by reason, kill this enemy in the form of Desire that is hard to overcome.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम् |विवस्वान्मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत् |
positive: Shree Bhagavan said: I taught this immortal Yoga to Vivasvan; Vivasvan conveyed it to Manu; and Manu imparted it toIksvaku.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः |स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप |
positive: Thus transmitted in succession from father to son, Arjuna, this Yoga remained known to the Rajarsis. It has, however, long since disappeared from this earth.
negative: Having attained the worlds of the righteous, the virtuous dwell there for a long time, and then the fallen yogi is born again in the house of the pure and prosperous.

query: स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः |भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम् |
positive: The same ancient Yoga has this day been imparted to you by Me, because you are My devotee and friend; and also because this is a supreme secret.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: अर्जुन उवाच |अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः |कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति |
positive: Arjuna said: You are of recent origin, while the birth of Vivasvan dates back to remote antiquity. How, then, am I to believe that You taught this Yoga at the beginning of creations?
negative: Arjuna, My birth and activities are divine. he who knows this in reality is not reborn on leaving his body, but comes to Me.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन |तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप |
positive: The Blessed Lord said: Many, many births both you and I have passed. I can remember all of them, but you cannot, O subduer of the enemy.
negative: Arjuna, My birth and activities are divine. he who knows this in reality is not reborn on leaving his body, but comes to Me.

query: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत |अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् |
positive: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.
negative: These, Arjuna, I speedily deliver from the ocean of birth and death, their mind being fixed on Me.

query: परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम् |धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे |
positive: For the protection of the virtuous, for the extirpation of evil-doers, and for establishing Dharmaon a firm footing, I born from age to age.
negative: For, I am the ground of the imperishable Brahma, of immortality, of the eternal virtue and of unending immutable bliss.

query: जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः |त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन |
positive: Arjuna, My birth and activities are divine. he who knows this in reality is not reborn on leaving his body, but comes to Me.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः |बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः |
positive: Completely rid of passion, fear and anger, wholly absorbed in me, depending on me, and purified by the penance of wisdom, many have become one with me even in the past.
negative: Otherbetake themselves to Me through their offering of Knowledge, worshipping Mewith undivided devotion, and others worship Me in many different ways as the Viratform of the Supreme Lord.

query: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः |क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा |
positive: In this world, the gods are eager for the success of works; indeed, in the human world, success is born of works. In this world of human beings; men seeking the fruition of their activities worship the gods; for success born of actions follow quickly.
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः |तस्य कर्तारमपि मां विद्ध्यकर्तारमव्ययम् |
positive: The four orders of societywere created by Me classifying them according to the mode of Prakrti predominant in each and apportioning corresponding duties to them;
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा |इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते |
positive: Since I have no craving for the fruit of actions; actions do not contaminate Me, Even he who thus knows Me in reality is not bound by actions.
negative: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves, nor desires and who renounces both good and evil actions and is full of devotion, is dear to Me.

query: एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः |कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम् |
positive: Having known thus, action was performed even by the ancient seekers for liberation; therefore do thou also perform action, as did the ancients in days of yore.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः |तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् |
positive: What is action and what is inaction? Even men of intelligence are puzzled over this question. Therefore, I shall expound to you the truth about action, knowing which you will be freed from its evil effect.
negative: If You are unequal even to the pursuit of such practice, be intent to work for Me; you shall attain perfectioneven by performing actions for My sake.

query: कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः |अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः |
positive: The truth about action must be known and the truth of inaction also must be known; even so the truth about prohibited action must be known. For mysterious are the ways of action.
negative: Even the wise call him a sage, whose undertaking are all free from desire and thoughts of the world, and whose actions are burnt up by the fire of wisdom.

query: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः |स बुद्धिमान्मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत् |
positive: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः |ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः |
positive: Even the wise call him a sage, whose undertaking are all free from desire and thoughts of the world, and whose actions are burnt up by the fire of wisdom.
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः |शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् |
positive: Having subdued his mind and body, and given up all objects of enjoyment, and free from craving; he who performs sheer bodily actions, does not incur sin.
negative: He, however, who takes delight in the self alone and is gratified with the Self, and is contented in the self, has no duty.

query: यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः |समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते |
positive: The Karmayogi, who is contented with whatever is got unsought, is free from jealousy and has transcended all pairs of opposites, and is balanced in success and failure, is not bound by his action.
negative: He who is unattached to everything, and meeting with good and evil, neither rejoices nor recoils, his mind is stable.

query: गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः |यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते |
positive: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.
negative: Even the wise call him a sage, whose undertaking are all free from desire and thoughts of the world, and whose actions are burnt up by the fire of wisdom.

query: ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्म हविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम् |ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना |
positive: In the practice of seeing Brahma everywhere as a form of sacrifice Brahma is the ladle; Brahma, again, is the oblation; Brahma is the fire, Brahma itself
negative: Those who are vowed to gods go to the gods; those who are vowed to the manes reach the manes; those who adore the spirits reach the spirits and those who worship Me come to Me alone..

query: श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति |शब्दादीन्विषयानन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति |
positive: Offer the sacrifice of the senses, beginning with the ears, to the self alone. Offer the sacrifice of the objects of the senses, beginning with sound, to the senses themselves.
negative: Those who are vowed to gods go to the gods; those who are vowed to the manes reach the manes; those who adore the spirits reach the spirits and those who worship Me come to Me alone..

query: सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे |आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते |
positive: Others sacrifice all the functions of their senses and the functions of the vital airs into the fire of Yoga in the shape of self-control, kindled by wisdom.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: अपाने जुह्वति प्राणं प्राणेऽपानं तथापरे |प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणाः |
positive: Other yogis offer the act of exhalation into that of inhalation even; so others, the act of inhalation into that of exhalation. There are still others given to the practice of Pranayama, who having regulated their diet and controlled the processes of exhalation and inhalation both pour their vital airs into the vital airs themselves.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम् |नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतोऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम |
positive: Those who eat the remnants of sacrifices go to the eternal Brahman; this world does not exist for one who does not perform sacrifices, how then can there be any fruit for him, O best of the Kurus?
negative: For, I am the ground of the imperishable Brahma, of immortality, of the eternal virtue and of unending immutable bliss.

query: एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे |कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे |
positive: Many such forms of sacrifice have been set forth in detail through the mouth of the Vedas. Knowing all these as actions of the mind, senses, and body, you shall be freed from all bondage of actions by performing them.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप |सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते |
positive: Arjuna, sacrifice through Knowledge is superior to sacrifice performed with material things. For all actions without exception culminate in Knowledge, O son of Kunti.
negative: Even the wise call him a sage, whose undertaking are all free from desire and thoughts of the world, and whose actions are burnt up by the fire of wisdom.

query: तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया |उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः |
positive: Understand the true nature of that Knowledge by approaching illumined soul. If you prostrate at their feet, render them service, and question them with an open and guileless heart, those wise seers of Truth will instruct you in that Knowledge.
negative: In the case, however, to those whose said ignorance has been set aside by true Knowledge of god, that wisdom shining like the sun reveals the supreme.

query: यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव |येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि (var अशेषाणि) |
positive: Arjuna, when you have reached enlightenment, ignorance will delude you no more. In the light of that Knowledge you will see the entire creation first within your own self, and then in Me.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः |सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि |
positive: Even though you were the foulest of all sinners, this Knowledge alone would carry you, like a raft, across all your sin.
negative: Even the wise call him a sage, whose undertaking are all free from desire and thoughts of the world, and whose actions are burnt up by the fire of wisdom.

query: यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन |ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा |
positive: For as the blazing fire turns the fuel to ashes, Arjuna, even so the fire of Knowledge turns all actions to ashes.
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते |तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति |
positive: On earth there is no purifier as great as Knowledge, he who has attained purity of heart through a prolonged practice of Karmayoga automatically sees the light of Truth in the self in course of time.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः |ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति |
positive: The faithful, the devoted, and the self-controlled attain knowledge; having obtained knowledge, they soon reach supreme peace.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: तस्मादज्ञानसम्भूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनात्मनः |छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत |
positive: Therefore, Arjuna, slashing to pieces, with the sword of wisdom, the doubt born of ignorance in your heart, stand firm in the yoga of equanimity and prepare for battle, O Bharata.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: अर्जुन उवाच |संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि |यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्चितम् |
positive: Arjuna said Krishna, you extol sankhyayogaand then the yoga of Action. Pray tell me which of the two is decidedly conducive to my good.
negative: Arjuna, My birth and activities are divine. he who knows this in reality is not reborn on leaving his body, but comes to Me.

query: साङ्ख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः |एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम् |
positive: It is the ignorant, not the wise, who say that Sankhyayoga and Karmayoga lead to divergent results. For one who is firmly established in either gets the fruit of both
negative: God determines not the doership nor the doings of men, nor even their contact with the fruit of actions; but it is Nature alone that functions.

query: संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः |योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति |
positive: Without Karmayoga, however, Sankhyayogais difficult to accomplish; whereas the Karmayogi, who keeps his mind fixed on God, reaches Brahma in no time, Arjuna.
negative: One who, having obtained the beloved, does not rejoice, and having obtained the unlovely, is not disturbed; that steady-minded, unbewildered knower of Brahman is ever established in the One Supreme Spirit.

query: योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः |सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते |
positive: The Karamayogi, who has fully conquered his mind and mastered his senses, whose heart is pure, and who has identified himself with the self of all beings, remains untainted, even though performing action.
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: नैव किञ्चित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित् |पश्यञ्शृण्वन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपञ्श्वसन् |
positive: The Sankhyayogi, however, who knows the reality of things, must believe, even though seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating or drinking, walking, sleeping, breathing, that he does nothing.
negative: Hardly anyone perceives this soul as marvellous, scarce another likewise speaks thereof as marvellous, and scarce another hears of it as marvellous; while there are some who know it not even on hearing of it.

query: प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि |इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन् |
positive: Speaking, letting go, grasping, opening or closing the eyes — holding that it is only the senses moving among their objects, he believes that he does nothing.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः |लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा |
positive: He who performs his duties, abandoning attachment and dedicating all actions to the Supreme, is not tainted by sin, just as a lotus leaf is untouched by water. He who acts offering all actions to God, and shaking off attachment, remains untouched by sin, as the lotus leaf by water.
negative: Having subdued his mind and body, and given up all objects of enjoyment, and free from craving; he who performs sheer bodily actions, does not incur sin.

query: कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि |योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये |
positive: The Karmayogis perform action only with their senses, mind, intellect and body as well, withdrawing the feeling of mine in respect of them and shaking off attachment simply for the sake of self-purification.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम् |अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते |
positive: One who is devoted to the path of selfless action attains lasting peace; one who is attached to the fruits of actions is bound by them. Offering the fruit of actions to God, the Karmayogi attains everlasting peace in the shape of God-Realization; whereas he who works with a selfish motive, being attached to the fruit of action through desire, gets tied down.
negative: The faithful, the devoted, and the self-controlled attain knowledge; having obtained knowledge, they soon reach supreme peace.

query: सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी |नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन् |
positive: The self-controlled Sankhyayoga, doing nothing himself and getting nothing done by others, rests happily in God, the embodiment, neither acting nor causing othersto act
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः |न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते |
positive: God determines not the doership nor the doings of men, nor even their contact with the fruit of actions; but it is Nature alone that functions.
negative: In this world that great soul has no use whatsoever for things done nor for things not done; nor has he selfish dependence of any kind on any creature.

query: नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः |अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः |
positive: The omnipresent God does not receive the virtue or sin of anyone. Knowledge is enveloped in ignorance; hence it is that beings are constantly falling a prey to delusion.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः |तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम् |
positive: In the case, however, to those whose said ignorance has been set aside by true Knowledge of god, that wisdom shining like the sun reveals the supreme.
negative: The faithful, the devoted, and the self-controlled attain knowledge; having obtained knowledge, they soon reach supreme peace.

query: विद्याविनयसम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि |शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः |
positive: The wise look with the same eye on a Brahmana endowed with learning and culture, a cow, an elephant, a dog, and a pariah too.
negative: The seers whose sins have been wiped out, whose doubts have been dispelled by Knowledge, whose disciplined mind is firmly established in God and who are actively engaged in the service of all beings, attain Brahma, who is all peace.

query: इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः |निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद् ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः |
positive: Even here is the mortal plane conquered by those whose mind is established in unity; since the Absolute is untouched by evil and knows no distinction, hence they are established in the Eternal.
negative: The seers whose sins have been wiped out, whose doubts have been dispelled by Knowledge, whose disciplined mind is firmly established in God and who are actively engaged in the service of all beings, attain Brahma, who is all peace.

query: न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम् |स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविद् ब्रह्मणि स्थितः |
positive: One who, having obtained the beloved, does not rejoice, and having obtained the unlovely, is not disturbed; that steady-minded, unbewildered knower of Brahman is ever established in the One Supreme Spirit.
negative: He who is not a source of annoyance to his fellow-creatures, and who in his turn does not feel vexed with fellow-creatures, and who is free from delight and envy perturbation and fear, is dear to Me.

query: बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम् |स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते |
positive: He whose mind remains unattached to sense-objects, derives through meditation the Sattvika joy which dwells in the mind; then that Yogi, having completely identified himself through meditation with Brahma enjoys eternal Bliss.
negative: He who is able to endure the force of desire and anger born of the mind before the destruction of the body, he is a yogi and he is happy.

query: ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते |आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः |
positive: The pleasures which are born of sense-contacts are verily a source of suffering only. They have a beginning and an end. Arjuna, it is for this reason that a wise man does not indulge in them.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात् |कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः |
positive: He who is able to endure the force of desire and anger born of the mind before the destruction of the body, he is a yogi and he is happy.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः |छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः |
positive: The seers whose sins have been wiped out, whose doubts have been dispelled by Knowledge, whose disciplined mind is firmly established in God and who are actively engaged in the service of all beings, attain Brahma, who is all peace.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम् |अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम् |
positive: To those wise men who are free from lust and anger, who have subdued their mind and have realized the Supreme Brahman, the all-pervading peaceful Supreme Brahman is present everywhere.
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः |विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः |
positive: he who has brought his senses, mind and intellect under control, who is devoted to liberation, free from desire, fear and anger, he is always free.
negative: Even the wise call him a sage, whose undertaking are all free from desire and thoughts of the world, and whose actions are burnt up by the fire of wisdom.

query: भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् |सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति |
positive: Having Known Me in reality as the enjoyer of all sacrifices and austerities, the supreme Lord of all the worlds, and the disinterested friend of all beings, My devotee attains peace.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये |मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि |
positive: Whatever other entities there are, born of Sattva, and those that are born of Rajasand Tamas, know them all as evolved from Me alone. In reality, however, neither do I exist in them, nor they in Me.
negative: Arjuna, My birth and activities are divine. he who knows this in reality is not reborn on leaving his body, but comes to Me.

query: त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत् |मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम् |
positive: The whole of this creation is deluded by these objects evolved from the three modes of Prakrti-Sattva, Rajas and Tamas; that is why the world fails to recognize Me, standing apart from these and imperishable.
negative: O Slayer of Madhu, I do not want to kill them, though they should slay me, even for the throne of the three worlds; how much the less from earthly lordship!

query: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया |मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते |
positive: This divine energy of Mine, consisting of the three modes of material nature, is difficult to overcome. But those who have surrendered unto Me alone can cross beyond it.
negative: But the results of their worship are limited and perishable; those who worship the gods go to the gods, but My devotees ultimately come to Me.

query: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः |माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः |
positive: Those whose wisdom has been carried away by Maya, and who have embraced the demoniac nature, such foolish and vile men of evil deeds do not adore Me.
negative: Since I have no craving for the fruit of actions; actions do not contaminate Me, Even he who thus knows Me in reality is not bound by actions.

query: तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते |प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः |
positive: Of these best is the man of wisdom, ever established in indentity with Me and possessed of exclusive devotion. For I am extremely dear to the wise man, and he is extremely dear to me.
negative: Thus the truth of the Ksetra and knowledge, as well as of the object worth knowing, God has been briefly discussed; knowing this in reality, My devotee enters into My Being.

query: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् |आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् |
positive: Indeed all these are noble, but the man of wisdom is My very self: such is My view. For such a devotee, who has his mind and intellect merged in Me, is firmly established in Me alone, the highest goal.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः |तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया |
positive: Those whose wisdom has been carried away by various desires, being prompted by their own nature, worship other deities adopting rules relating to each.
negative: The Karamayogi, who has fully conquered his mind and mastered his senses, whose heart is pure, and who has identified himself with the self of all beings, remains untainted, even though performing action.

query: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति |तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम् |
positive: Whatever celestial form a devoteeworships with faith, I make that faith of his steady.
negative: Endowed with such faith he worship that particular deity and obtains through him without doubt his desired enjoyments as ordained by Myself.

query: स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते |लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान् |
positive: Endowed with such faith he worship that particular deity and obtains through him without doubt his desired enjoyments as ordained by Myself.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् |देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि |
positive: But the results of their worship are limited and perishable; those who worship the gods go to the gods, but My devotees ultimately come to Me.
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः |परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम् |
positive: Not knowing My unsurpassable and undecaying supreme nature, the ignorant believe Me, the supreme Spirit beyond the reach of mind and senses, the embodiment of Truth, Knowledge and Bliss, to have assumed a finite form through birth.
negative: Since I have no craving for the fruit of actions; actions do not contaminate Me, Even he who thus knows Me in reality is not bound by actions.

query: नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः |मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम् |
positive: Veiled by My Yogamaya; I am not manifest to all. Hence these ignorant folk fail to recognize Me, the unborn and imperishable Supreme Deity.
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत |सर्वभूतानि सम्मोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप |
positive: O valiant Arjuna, through delusion in the shape of pairs of opposites, born of desire and hatred, all living creatures in this world are falling a prey to infatuation.
negative: Die, and you will win heaven; conquer, and you enjoy sovereignty of the earth; therefore, stand up, Arjuna, determined to fight.

query: येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् |ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः |
positive: But those who have their sins destroyed by performing the best actions without attachment, they, freed from delusion born of desire and hatred, worship Me with firm determination.
negative: If You are unequal even to the pursuit of such practice, be intent to work for Me; you shall attain perfectioneven by performing actions for My sake.

query: जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये |ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् |
positive: They who, having taken refuge in Me, strive for deliverance from old age and death know Brahma, the whole Adhyatma, and the entire field of Karma.
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन |प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः |
positive: Krishna, who is Adhiyajña here and how does he dwell in the body? And how are You to be realized at the time of death by those of steadfast mind?
negative: Through that supreme devotion he comes to know Me in reality, what and how great I am; and thereby knowing Me in essence he forthwith enters into My being.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते |भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः |
positive: Shree Bhagavan said: The supreme Indestructible is Brahma; one’s own selfis called Adhyatma; and the cause of the origin of beings is called Karma.
negative: Arjuna, My birth and activities are divine. he who knows this in reality is not reborn on leaving his body, but comes to Me.

query: अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् |यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः |
positive: Whoever, at the time of death, remembering Me alone, quits his body, he attains My being; there is no doubt about this.
negative: He who, offering the highest love to Me, preaches the most profound gospel of the gita among my devotees, shall come to me alone, there is no doubt about it.

query: यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम् |तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः |
positive: Arjuna, thinking of whatever entity one leaves the body at the time of death, that and that alone one attains, being ever absorbed in its thought.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च |मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयः (orसंशयम्) |
positive: Therefore, Arjuna, at all times remember Me and fight. With your mind and intellect dedicated to Me, you will surely come to Me without doubt.
negative: Having restrained all the senses, even-minded everywhere, intent on the welfare of all beings verily they also come unto Me

query: अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना |परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन् |
positive: Arjuna, he who with his mind disciplined through Yoga in the form of practice of meditation and thinking of nothing else, is constantly engaged in contemplation of God attains the supremely effulgent divine Purusha.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेनभक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव |भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम् |
positive: At the time of departure, with a mind steady in devotion and united by the strength of yoga, firmly establishing the life force in the middle of the eyebrows, one attains that supreme divine person.
negative: He who is able to endure the force of desire and anger born of the mind before the destruction of the body, he is a yogi and he is happy.

query: यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्तिविशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः |यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्तितत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये |
positive: I shall tell you briefly about that supreme goal, which the knowers of the Veda term as the Indestructible; which striving recluses free from passion enter, and
negative: Arjuna said: The devotees who, with their minds constantly fixed on You as shown above, adore You as possessed of form and attributes, and those who adore as the supreme Reality

query: सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च |मूध्न्यार्धायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम् |
positive: Having closed all the doors of the senses, and firmly holding the mind in the cavity of the heart, and then fixing the life-breath in the head, and thus remaining steadfast in Yogic concentration on God, he who leaves the body and departs uttering the one indestructible Brahma, Om, and dwelling on Me in My absolute aspect, reaches the supreme goal.
negative: Having attained the worlds of the righteous, the virtuous dwell there for a long time, and then the fallen yogi is born again in the house of the pure and prosperous.

query: ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन् |यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् |
positive: Uttering the one-syllabled Om the Brahman and remembering Me, he who departs, leaving the body, attains to the Supreme Goal.
negative: Endowed with such faith he worship that particular deity and obtains through him without doubt his desired enjoyments as ordained by Myself.

query: अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः |तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः |
positive: Arjuna, whosoever always and constantly thinks of Me with undivided mind, to that Yogi ever absorbed in Me I am easily attainable.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् |नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः |
positive: Having attained Me, the great souls who have reached the supreme perfection do not take birth again in this miserable and temporary world.
negative: Having attained the worlds of the righteous, the virtuous dwell there for a long time, and then the fallen yogi is born again in the house of the pure and prosperous.

query: सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद् ब्रह्मणो विदुः |रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः |
positive: Those Yogis who know from realization Brahma’s day as covering a thousand Mahayugas, and his night as ending in a thousand Mahayugas, know the reality about time.
negative: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, behold presently in hundreds and thousands, My multifarious divine forms, of various colours and shapes.

query: अव्यक्ताद् व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे |रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके |
positive: All embodied beings emanate from the Unmanifestat the coming of the cosmic day; at the cosmic nightfall they merge into the same subtle body of Brahma, known as the Unmanifest.
negative: For I am the enjoyer and also the lord of all sacrifices; but they know Me not in reality, hence they fall.

query: भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते |रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे |
positive: Arjuna, this multitude of beings, being born again and again, is dissolved under compulsion of its nature at the coming of the cosmic night, and rises again at the commencement of the cosmic day.
negative: And the excellent archer, the King of Kasi and Sikhandi the Maharathi,

query: परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः |यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति |
positive: Beyond that is another, beyond the unmanifest, the eternal unmanifested. He is the Supreme Divine Person who does not perish even when all beings perish.
negative: He, however, who takes delight in the self alone and is gratified with the Self, and is contented in the self, has no duty.

query: अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम् |यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम |
positive: The same Unmanifest which has been spoken of as the Indestructible is also called the supreme Goal; that again is My supreme Abode, attaining which they return not to this mortal world.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया |यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् |
positive: Arjuna, that eternal unmanifest supreme Purusha in whom all beings reside, and by whom all this is pervaded, is attainable only through exclusive Devotion.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः |प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ |
positive: Arjuna, I shall now tell you the timedeparting when Yogis do not return, and the time when they do return; I shall explain both, O best of the Bharatas.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: अग्निर्जोतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् |तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः |
positive: the one is that which are stationed the all-effulgent fire-god and the deities presiding over daylight, the bright fortnight, and the six months of the northward course of the sun respectively; proceeding along it after death Yogis, who have known Brahma, being successively led by the above gods, finally reach Brahma.
negative: Those who are vowed to gods go to the gods; those who are vowed to the manes reach the manes; those who adore the spirits reach the spirits and those who worship Me come to Me alone..

query: नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन |तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन |
positive: Knowing thus the secret of these two paths, O son of Kunti, no Yogi gets deluded. Therefore, Arjuna, at all times be steadfast in Yoga in the form of equanimity.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैवदानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम् |अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वायोगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम् |
positive: The Yogi, realizing this profound truth, doubtless transcends all the rewards, ascribed in the scriptures to the study of the Vedas, as well as to the performance of sacrifices, austerities and charities, and attains the beginningless supreme state.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप |अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि |
positive: O Arjuna, those who have no faith in this dharma, O conqueror of enemies, they do not attain Me, but return to the cycle of birth and death.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना |मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः |
positive: The whole of this universe is permeated by Me as unmanifest Divinity, and all beings rest on the idea within Me. Therefore, really speaking, I am not present in them.
negative: He who sees Mepresent in all beings, and all beings existing within Me, never loses sight of Me, and I never lose sight of him.

query: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् |भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः |
positive: Not in beings do I abide, behold My divine Yoga power. I am the sustainer and creator of beings, yet My Self is not in them.
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् |तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय |
positive: Just as the extensive air, which is moving everywhere,ever remains in ether, likewise know that all beingsabide in Me.
negative: It has hands and feet on all sides, eyes, head and mouth in all directions, and ears all round; for it stands pervading all in the universe.

query: सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम् |कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम् |
positive: Arjuna, during the Final Dissolution all beings enter My Prakrti, and at the beginning of creation, I send them forth again.
negative: Arjuna, know that all beings have evolved from this twofold Prakrti, and that I am the source of the entire creation, and into Me again it disappears.

query: प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः |भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात् |
positive: Wielding My Nature I release, again and again,all this multitude of beings subject to the influence of their own nature.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय |उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु |
positive: Arjuna, those actions, however, do not bind Me, unattached as I am to such actions and standing apart as it were.
negative: Since I have no craving for the fruit of actions; actions do not contaminate Me, Even he who thus knows Me in reality is not bound by actions.

query: मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम् |हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते |
positive: Arjuna; with Me as the supervisor, Nature brings forth the whole creation, consisting of both sentient and insentient beings; it is due to this cause that the wheel of Samsara is going round.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम् |परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् |
positive: Fools, not knowing My supreme nature, think low of Me, the Overlord of the entire creation, who have put on the human semblance..
negative: For I am the enjoyer and also the lord of all sacrifices; but they know Me not in reality, hence they fall.

query: मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः |राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः |
positive: Those who have deluded minds, engaged in fruitless hopes, fruitless actions, and fruitless knowledge, are attached to the demonic, demoniac, and deluding modes of nature.
negative: And the excellent archer, the King of Kasi and Sikhandi the Maharathi,

query: महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः |भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम् |
positive: On the other hand, Arjuna, great souls who have embraced the divine nature, knowing Me as the prime source of all lives and the imperishable eternal, worship Me constantly with none else in mind.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः |नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते |
positive: Constantly chanting My names and glories and striving for My realization, and bowing again and again to Me, those devotees of firm resolve, ever united with Me through meditation, worship Me with single-minded devotion.
