query: ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते |एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् |
positive: Otherbetake themselves to Me through their offering of Knowledge, worshipping Mewith undivided devotion, and others worship Me in many different ways as the Viratform of the Supreme Lord.
negative: The faithful, the devoted, and the self-controlled attain knowledge; having obtained knowledge, they soon reach supreme peace.

query: अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम् |मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम् |
positive: I am the Vedic ritual, I am the sacrifice, I am the offering to the departed; I am the herbage and foodgrains; I am the sacred formula, I am the clarified butter, I am the sacred fire, and I am verily the act of offering oblations into the fire.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: पिताहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः |वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक्साम यजुरेव च |
positive: I am the father of this world, the mother, the support, and the grandsire; I am the object of knowledge, the purifier, the syllable Om; I am the Rig, Sama, and Yajur Vedas.
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् |प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् |
positive: I am the supreme goal, supporter, lord, witness, abode, refuge, wellwisher seeking no return, origin and end, resting-place, storehouse, and imperishable seed.
negative: Thus the truth of the Ksetra and knowledge, as well as of the object worth knowing, God has been briefly discussed; knowing this in reality, My devotee enters into My Being.

query: तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च |अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन |
positive: I radiate heat as the sun, and hold back as well as send forth showers, Arjuna. I am immortality as well as death; even so I am being and non-being both.
negative: For, I am the ground of the imperishable Brahma, of immortality, of the eternal virtue and of unending immutable bliss.

query: त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापायज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते |ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक-मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान् |
positive: Those who perform sacrifices with faith, drinking soma and free from sin, desire to reach heaven by worshiping Me. They attain the world of the gods and enjoy divine pleasures there.
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते |तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् |
positive: The devotees, however, who loving no one else constantly think of Me, and worship Me in a disinterested spirit, to those ever united in thought with Me I bring full security and personally attend to their needs.
negative: On those ever united through meditation, with Me and worshipping Me with love, I confer that Yoga of wisdom through which they come to Me.

query: येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः |तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम् |
positive: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.
negative: Endowed with such faith he worship that particular deity and obtains through him without doubt his desired enjoyments as ordained by Myself.

query: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च |न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते |
positive: For I am the enjoyer and also the lord of all sacrifices; but they know Me not in reality, hence they fall.
negative: I shall unfold to you in its entirety this wisdomalong with the Knowledge of the qualified aspect of God, having known which nothing else remains yet to be known in this world.

query: यान्ति देवव्रता देवान्पितॄन्यान्ति पितृव्रताः |भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम् |
positive: Those who are vowed to gods go to the gods; those who are vowed to the manes reach the manes; those who adore the spirits reach the spirits and those who worship Me come to Me alone..
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति |तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः |
positive: Whoever offers Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water, I accept that pure-hearted devotee’s offering with love.
negative: Endowed with such faith he worship that particular deity and obtains through him without doubt his desired enjoyments as ordained by Myself.

query: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः |ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम् |
positive: I am equally present in all beings; there is none hateful or dear to Me. They, however, who devoutly worship Me abide in Me; and I too stand revealed in them.
negative: Among men there is none who does me a more loving service than he, nor shall anyone be dearer to me on the entire globe than he.

query: क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति |कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति |
positive: Speedily he becomes virtuous and secures lasting peace. Know it for certain, Arjuna, that My devotee never falls.
negative: One who, having obtained the beloved, does not rejoice, and having obtained the unlovely, is not disturbed; that steady-minded, unbewildered knower of Brahman is ever established in the One Supreme Spirit.

query: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः |स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् |
positive: Arjuna, women, VaisyasSudras, as well as those of vile birth, whoever they may be, taking refuge in Me they too attain the supreme goal.

query: किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा |अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम् |
positive: How much more, then, holy Brahmanas and royal sages devoted to Me! Therefore, having obtained this joyless and transient human life, constantly worship Me.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः |यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया |
positive: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, hear once again My supreme word, which I shall speak to you, who are so loving, out of solicitude for your welfare.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः |अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः |
positive: Neither gods nor the great sages know the secret of My birth; for I am the prime cause in all respects of gods as well as of the great seers.
negative: Among men there is none who does me a more loving service than he, nor shall anyone be dearer to me on the entire globe than he.

query: बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसम्मोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः |सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च |
positive: Reason, right knowledge, unclouded understanding, forbearance, veracity, control over the senses and mind, joy and sorrow, evolution and dissolution, fear and fearlessness—these diverse traits of creatures emanate from me alone.
negative: Thus the truth of the Ksetra and knowledge, as well as of the object worth knowing, God has been briefly discussed; knowing this in reality, My devotee enters into My Being.

query: अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः |भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः |
positive: Non-violence, equanimity, contentment, austerity, charity, fame and obloquy—these diverse traits of creatures emanate from me alone.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा |मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः |
positive: Seven great sages, four ancient Manus, and the fourteen progenitors including Sanaka and others, all these beings with minds born of me, have arisen by my will; their progeny fills the world.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः |सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः |
positive: He who knows in reality this supreme divine glory and supernatural power of Mine gets established in Me through unfaltering Devotion; of this there is no doubt.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते |इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः |
positive: I am the origin of all; everything proceeds from Me. Understanding this, the wise worship Me with devotion.
negative: For I am the enjoyer and also the lord of all sacrifices; but they know Me not in reality, hence they fall.

query: मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् |कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च |
positive: With their mind fixed on Me, and their lives surrendered to Me, enlightening one another about My greatness and speaking of Me, My devotees ever remain contented and take delight in Me.
negative: On those ever united through meditation, with Me and worshipping Me with love, I confer that Yoga of wisdom through which they come to Me.

query: तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् |ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते |
positive: On those ever united through meditation, with Me and worshipping Me with love, I confer that Yoga of wisdom through which they come to Me.
negative: With their mind fixed on Me, and their lives surrendered to Me, enlightening one another about My greatness and speaking of Me, My devotees ever remain contented and take delight in Me.

query: तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः |नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता |
positive: In order to shower My grace on them I, dwelling in their heart, dispel the darkness born of ignorance by the shining light of wisdom.
negative: The faithful, the devoted, and the self-controlled attain knowledge; having obtained knowledge, they soon reach supreme peace.

query: अर्जुन उवाच |परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् |पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम् |
positive: Arjuna said: You are the transcendent Eternal, the supreme Abode and the greatest purifier; all the seers speak of You as the eternal divine Purusha, the primal Deity, unborn and all-pervading.
negative: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, now I shall tell you My conspicuous divine glories; for there is no limit to My magnitude.

query: आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा |असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे |
positive: Likewise speak the celestial sage Narada, the sages Asita and Devala and the great sage Vyasa; and Yourself too proclaim this to me.
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव |न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः |
positive: Krishna, I believe as true all that You tell me, Lord, neither demons nor gods are aware of Your manifestation through sport.
negative: He who sees Mepresent in all beings, and all beings existing within Me, never loses sight of Me, and I never lose sight of him.

query: स्वयमेवात्मनात्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम |भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते |
positive: O creator of beings, O Ruler of creatures, O God of gods, the Lord of the universe, O supreme Purusha, You alone know what You are by Yourself.
negative: Your divine form possessed of wisdom, glory, energy, strength, valour and effulgence, O best of persons!

query: वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः |याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि |
positive: Therefore, You alone can describe in full Your divine glories, whereby You stand pervading all these worlds.
negative: Those who are vowed to gods go to the gods; those who are vowed to the manes reach the manes; those who adore the spirits reach the spirits and those who worship Me come to Me alone..

query: कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन् |केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया |
positive: O Master of Yoga, through what process of continuous meditation shall I know You? And in what particular forms, O Lord, are You to be meditated upon by me?
negative: On those ever united through meditation, with Me and worshipping Me with love, I confer that Yoga of wisdom through which they come to Me.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः |प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे |
positive: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, now I shall tell you My conspicuous divine glories; for there is no limit to My magnitude.
negative: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, hear once again My supreme word, which I shall speak to you, who are so loving, out of solicitude for your welfare.

query: अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः |अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च |
positive: Arjuna I am the universal Self seated in the heart of all beings; so I alone am the beginning and middle and also the end of all beings.
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः |इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना |
positive: Among the Vedas, I am the Samaveda; among the gods, I am Indra. Among the organs of perception etc., I am the mind; and I am the consciousnessin living beings.
negative: Those who are vowed to gods go to the gods; those who are vowed to the manes reach the manes; those who adore the spirits reach the spirits and those who worship Me come to Me alone..

query: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम् |सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः |
positive: Among the priests, Arjuna, know Me to be their chief, Brhaspati. Among warrior-chiefs, I am Skanda; and among the waters; I am the ocean.
negative: O best of the Bharatas, I am the strength of the strong, devoid of desire and passion; and I am the desire in beings, not opposed to dharma.

query: अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः |गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः |
positive: Among all trees, I am the Asvattha; among the celestial sages, Narada; among the Gandharvas, Citraratha; and among the Siddhas, I am the sage Kapila.
negative: And the excellent archer, the King of Kasi and Sikhandi the Maharathi,

query: उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम् |ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम् |
positive: Among horses, know Me to be the celestial horse Uccaihsrava, begotten of the churning of the ocean along with nectar; among mighty elephants Airavata; and among men, the king.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् |प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः |
positive: Among weapons, I am the thunderbolt; among cows, I am the celestial cow Kamadhenu. I am the sexual desire which leads to procreation; among serpents, I am Vasuki.
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम् |पितॄणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम् |
positive: Among Nagas, I am the serpent-god Ananta; and I am Varuna, the lord of aquatic creatures. Among the manes, I am Aryama, and among rulers, I am Yama.
negative: Having restrained all the senses, even-minded everywhere, intent on the welfare of all beings verily they also come unto Me

query: प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम् |मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् |
positive: Among the Daityas, I am the great devotee Prahlada; and among reckoners, I am Time. So among quadrupeds, I am the lion; and among birds, I am Garuda.
negative: For, I am the ground of the imperishable Brahma, of immortality, of the eternal virtue and of unending immutable bliss.

query: मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् |कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा |
positive: I am the all-destroying Death that snatches all, and the origin of all that shall be born. Among women, I am Kirti, Shree, Vak, Smrti, Medha, Dhrti and Ksama.
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम् |मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः |
positive: Likewise among the Srutis that can be sung, I am the variety known as Brhatsama; while among the Vedic hymns, I am the hymn known as Gayatri. Again, among the twelve months of the Hindu calendar; I am the month Margasirsha and among the seasons, I am the spring.
negative: And the excellent archer, the King of Kasi and Sikhandi the Maharathi,

query: द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् |जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम् |
positive: I am gambling among deceitful practices, and the glory of the glorious. I am the victory of the victorious, the resolve of the resolute, the goodness of the good.
negative: O best of the Bharatas, I am the strength of the strong, devoid of desire and passion; and I am the desire in beings, not opposed to dharma.

query: वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनञ्जयः |मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः |
positive: Among the Vrishnis I am Vasudeva, among the Pandavas I am Dhananjaya; among the sages I am Vyasa, and among poets I am the poet Ushanas.
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम् |मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् |
positive: I am the subduing power in rulers; I am righteousness in those who seek to conquer. Of things to be kept secret, I am the custodian in the shape of reticence; and I am the wisdom of the wise.
negative: Since I have no craving for the fruit of actions; actions do not contaminate Me, Even he who thus knows Me in reality is not bound by actions.

query: यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन |न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् |
positive: Arjuna, I am even that which is the seed of all life. For there is no creature, moving or inert, which exists without Me.
negative: Having subdued his mind and body, and given up all objects of enjoyment, and free from craving; he who performs sheer bodily actions, does not incur sin.

query: नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप |एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया |
positive: Arjuna, there is no limit to My divine manifestation. This is only a brief description by Me of the extent of My glory.
negative: Those who are vowed to gods go to the gods; those who are vowed to the manes reach the manes; those who adore the spirits reach the spirits and those who worship Me come to Me alone..

query: यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा |तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम् |
positive: Whatever is endowed with existence, consciousness, and glory, know that to be a manifestation of a part of My splendor.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन |विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत् |
positive: Or, what will you gain by knowing all this in detail, Arjuna? Suffice it to say that I stand holding this entire universe by a fraction of My Yogic power.
negative: That, however, by which man cognize many existences of various kinds as apart from one another in all beings, know that knowledge to be Rajasika.

query: अर्जुन उवाच |मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् |यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम |
positive: Arjuna said: Thanks to the most profound words of spiritual wisdom that You have spoken out of kindness to me, this delusion of mine has entirely disappeared.
negative: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, now I shall tell you My conspicuous divine glories; for there is no limit to My magnitude.

query: एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर |द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम |
positive: Your divine form possessed of wisdom, glory, energy, strength, valour and effulgence, O best of persons!
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो |योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयात्मानमव्ययम् |
positive: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः |नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च |
positive: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, behold presently in hundreds and thousands, My multifarious divine forms, of various colours and shapes.
negative: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, now I shall tell you My conspicuous divine glories; for there is no limit to My magnitude.

query: पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा |बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याश्चर्याणि भारत |
positive: Behold in Me the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Ashvins, and also the Maruts, O Bharata, and many wonders never seen before.
negative: And the excellent archer, the King of Kasi and Sikhandi the Maharathi,

query: इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम् |मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद् द्रष्टुमिच्छसि |
positive: Arjuna, behold as concentrated within this body of Mine the entire creation consisting of both animate and inanimate beings, and whatever else you desire to see.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा |दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् |
positive: But surely you cannot see Me with these human eyes of yours; therefore, I vouchsafe to you the divine eye. With this you behold My divine power of Yoga.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: सञ्जय उवाच |एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः |दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम् |
positive: Sanjaya said: My lord! having spoken thus, Shree Krishna, the supreme Master of Yoga, forthwith revealed to Arjuna His supremely glorious divine Form.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् |अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम् |
positive: Arjuna saw the supreme Deity possessing many mouths and eyes, presenting many a wonderful sight, decked with many divine ornaments, wielding many uplifted divine weapons,
negative: Those whose wisdom has been carried away by various desires, being prompted by their own nature, worship other deities adopting rules relating to each.

query: दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् |सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम् |
positive: wearing divine garlands and clothes, besmeared all over with divine sandal-pastes, full of all wonders, infinite and having faces on all sides.
negative: Whatever celestial form a devoteeworships with faith, I make that faith of his steady.

query: तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा |अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा |
positive: Concentrated at one place in the person of that supreme Deity, Arjuna then beheld the whole universe with its manifold divisions.
negative: Therefore, You alone can describe in full Your divine glories, whereby You stand pervading all these worlds.

query: अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रंपश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम् |नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिंपश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप |
positive: O lord of the universe, I see You endowed with numerous arms, bellies, mouths, and eyes and having innumerable forms extended on all sides. I see neither Your beginning nor middle, nor even Your end, manifested as You are in the form of the universe.
negative: I shall unfold to you in its entirety this wisdomalong with the Knowledge of the qualified aspect of God, having known which nothing else remains yet to be known in this world.

query: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं चतेजोराशिं सर्वतो दीप्तिमन्तम् |पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ताद्दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम् |
positive: I see You endowed with diadems, clubs and discuses, a mass of splendour flaming all round, having the brilliance of a blazing fire and the sun, hard to gaze at and immeasurable on all sides.
negative: Krishna, it behoves You to slash this doubt of mine completely; for none other than You can be found, who can tear this doubt.

query: त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यंत्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् |त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्तासनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे |
positive: You are the supreme indestructible worthy of being known; You are the ultimate refuge of this universe. You are, again, the protector of the ageless Dharma; I consider You to be the eternal imperishable Being.
negative: Having restrained all the senses, even-minded everywhere, intent on the welfare of all beings verily they also come unto Me

query: अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य-मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम् |पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रंस्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् |
positive: I see You without beginning, middle or end, possessing unlimited prowess and endowed with numberless arms, having the moon and the sun for Your eyes, and blazing fire for Your mouth, and scorching this universe by Your radiance.
negative: Whatever celestial form a devoteeworships with faith, I make that faith of his steady.

query: द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हिव्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः |दृष्ट्वाद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदंलोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन् |
positive: Yonder space between heaven and earth and all the quarters are entirely filled by You alone. Seeing this transcendent, dreadful form of yours, O sould of the universe, all the three worlds feels greatly alarmed.
negative: Therefore, You alone can describe in full Your divine glories, whereby You stand pervading all these worlds.

query: अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घा विशन्तिकेचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति |स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाःस्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः |
positive: Yonder hosts of gods are entering You; some with palms joined out of fear are uttering Your names and glories. Multitudes of Maharsis and Siddhas, saying ‘Let there be peace’, are extolling You by means of excellent hymns.
negative: With their mind fixed on Me, and their lives surrendered to Me, enlightening one another about My greatness and speaking of Me, My devotees ever remain contented and take delight in Me.

query: नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णंव्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम् |दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्माधृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो |
positive: Because, O Vishnu! touching the sky, radiant, adorned with many colors, with spreading mouths and large luminous eyes, seeing You, my inner self is terrified; I cannot maintain my composure or peace.
negative: He who is not a source of annoyance to his fellow-creatures, and who in his turn does not feel vexed with fellow-creatures, and who is free from delight and envy perturbation and fear, is dear to Me.

query: दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानिदृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि |दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्मप्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास |
positive: Seeing Your faces frightful on account of their teeth, and flaring like the fire at the time of universal destruction, I am utterly bewildered and find no happiness; therefore, be kind to me, O Lord of celestials and Resting-place of the universe.
negative: He who is not a source of annoyance to his fellow-creatures, and who in his turn does not feel vexed with fellow-creatures, and who is free from delight and envy perturbation and fear, is dear to Me.

query: अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राःसर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः |भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथासौसहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः |
positive: All those sons of Dhrtarastra with hosts of kings are entering You.Bhishma, Drona and yonder Karna, with the principal warriors on our side as well, are rushing headlong into Your fearful mouths.
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्तिदंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि |केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषुसन्दृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः |
positive: Rushing into Your fearful mouths looking all the more terrible on account of their teeth, some are seen stuck up in the gaps between Your teeth with their heads crushed.
negative: Those whose wisdom has been carried away by Maya, and who have embraced the demoniac nature, such foolish and vile men of evil deeds do not adore Me.

query: यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गाविशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः |तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोकास्-तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः |
positive: As moths rush with great speed into the blazing fire for extinction out of their folly, even so all these people are with great rapidity entering Your mouths to meet their doom.
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ताल्-लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः |तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रंभासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो |
positive: Thou lickest up, devouring all the worlds on every side with Thy flaming mouths. Thy fierce rays, filling the whole world with radiance, are burning, O Vishnu!
negative: Having attained the worlds of the righteous, the virtuous dwell there for a long time, and then the fallen yogi is born again in the house of the pure and prosperous.

query: आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपोनमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद |विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यंन हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम् |
positive: Tell me who You are with a form so terrible. My obeisance to You, O best of gods; be kind to me, I wish to know You, the Primal Being, in particular; for I know not Your purpose.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्वजित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम् |मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेवनिमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन् |
positive: Therefore, arise, gain fame, conquer the enemies, and enjoy a prosperous kingdom with wealth and resources. These brave warriors have already been slain by Me. O Savyasachin, you are only the instrument.
negative: And keep it there till I have carefully observed these warriors drawn up for battle, and have seen with whom I have to engage in this fight.

query: सञ्जय उवाच |एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्यकृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी |नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णंसगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य |
positive: Sanjaya said: Hearing these words of Bhagavan Keshava, Arjuna tremblingly bowed to Him with joined palms, and bowing again in extreme terror spoke to Shree Krishna in faltering accents.
negative: Krishna, it behoves You to slash this doubt of mine completely; for none other than You can be found, who can tear this doubt.

query: अर्जुन उवाच |स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्याजगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च |रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्तिसर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः |
positive: Arjuna said: Lord, well it is the universe exults and is filled with love by chanting Your names, virtues and glory; terrified Raksasas are fleeing in all directions, and all the hosts of Siddhas are bowing to You.
negative: Die, and you will win heaven; conquer, and you enjoy sovereignty of the earth; therefore, stand up, Arjuna, determined to fight.

query: कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे |अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवासत्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत् |
positive: O great soul, why should they not bow to You, who are the progenitor of Brahma himself and the greatest of the great? O infinite Lord of celestials, Abode of the universe, You are that which is existent, that which is non-existentand also that which is beyond both, viz., the indestructible Brahma.
negative: One who, having obtained the beloved, does not rejoice, and having obtained the unlovely, is not disturbed; that steady-minded, unbewildered knower of Brahman is ever established in the One Supreme Spirit.

query: त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराणस्-त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् |वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धामत्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप |
positive: You are the primal Deity, the most ancient Person; You are the ultimate resort of this universe. You are both the knower and the knowable, and the highest abode. It is You who pervade the universe, assuming endless forms.
negative: The same ancient Yoga has this day been imparted to you by Me, because you are My devotee and friend; and also because this is a supreme secret.

query: वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कःप्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च |नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वःपुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते |
positive: You are Vayu, Yama, Agni, the moon-god, Brahma, nay, the father of Brahma Himself. Hail, hail to You a thousand times; salutations, repeated salutations O You once again.
negative: Those who are vowed to gods go to the gods; those who are vowed to the manes reach the manes; those who adore the spirits reach the spirits and those who worship Me come to Me alone..

query: नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्तेनमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व |अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वंसर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः |
positive: O Lord of infinite prowess, my salutations to You from before and from behind. O soul of all, my obeisance to You from all sides indeed. You, who possess limitless might, pervade all; therefore, You are all.
negative: Arjuna, during the Final Dissolution all beings enter My Prakrti, and at the beginning of creation, I send them forth again.

query: सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तंहे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति |अजानता महिमानं तवेदंमया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि |
positive: O Krishna, O Yadava, O friend! Thinking of You as a mere companion, whatever I have said rashly, without understanding Your greatness, and disrespectfully in jest, while at play, reposing, sitting or at meals, either alone or before others, for all that I crave forgiveness from You, who are immeasurable.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसिविहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु |एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षंतत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम् |
positive: And whatever insult I may have offered to You in jest, while at play, resting, sitting, or at meals, either alone or in front of others, O Infallible One, I implore You, the immeasurable, to forgive me.
negative: Endowed with such faith he worship that particular deity and obtains through him without doubt his desired enjoyments as ordained by Myself.

query: पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्यत्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान् |न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्योलोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव |
positive: You are the father of all moving and non-moving beings, the greatest of gurus, and eminently worthy of worship. There is no one superior to You; how then can there be anyone equal to You in the three worlds?
negative: O creator of beings, O Ruler of creatures, O God of gods, the Lord of the universe, O supreme Purusha, You alone know what You are by Yourself.

query: तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायंप्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम् |पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युःप्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम् |
positive: Therefore, Lord, prostrating my body at Your feet and bowing low I seek to propitiate You, the ruler of all and worthy of all praise. It behoves You to bear with me even as father bears with his son, a friend with his friend and a husband with his beloved spouse,
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वाभयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे |तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपंप्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास |
positive: Having Seen Your wondrous form, which was never seen before, I feel transported with joy; at the same time my mind is tormented by fear. Pray reveal to me that divine form; the form of Visnu with four arms; O Lord of celestials Abode of the universe, be gracious.
negative: Seeing Your faces frightful on account of their teeth, and flaring like the fire at the time of universal destruction, I am utterly bewildered and find no happiness; therefore, be kind to me, O Lord of celestials and Resting-place of the universe.

query: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्तंइच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव |तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेनसहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते |
positive: I wish to see You wearing the crown, holding the mace and discus in Your hands. Therefore, O thousand-armed one, O universal form, manifest Yourself in that four-armed form.Seeing such a dreadful Form of Mine as this, be not perturbed or perplexed; with a fearless and complacent mind, behold once more this My form adorned with conch, discus, mace and lotus.
negative: Krishna, it behoves You to slash this doubt of mine completely; for none other than You can be found, who can tear this doubt.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदंरूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात् |तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यंयन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम् |
positive: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna! pleased with you I have shown you, through My own power of Yoga, this supreme, effulgent, primal and infinite Cosmic Body, which was never seen before by any else than you.
negative: He who sees Mepresent in all beings, and all beings existing within Me, never loses sight of Me, and I never lose sight of him.

query: न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानैर्-न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः |एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोकेद्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर |
positive: Arjuna, in this mortal world I cannot be seen in this Form by anyone else than you, either through study of the Vedas or of rituals, or a gain through gifts, actions or austere penances.
negative: Since I have no craving for the fruit of actions; actions do not contaminate Me, Even he who thus knows Me in reality is not bound by actions.

query: मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावोदृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम् |व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वंतदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य |
positive: Seeing such a dreadful Form of Mine as this, be not perturbed or perplexed; with a fearless and complacent mind, behold once again the same four-armed Form of Mine.
negative: With their mind fixed on Me, and their lives surrendered to Me, enlightening one another about My greatness and speaking of Me, My devotees ever remain contented and take delight in Me.

query: सञ्जय उवाच |इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वास्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः |आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनंभूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा |
positive: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus to Arjuna, Bhagavan Vasudeva again showed to him in the same way His own four-armed form; and then, assuming a gentle form, the high-souled Shree Krishna consoled the frightened Arjuna.
negative: Having attained the worlds of the righteous, the virtuous dwell there for a long time, and then the fallen yogi is born again in the house of the pure and prosperous.

query: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया |शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा |
positive: Neither by study of the Vedas nor by penance, nor again by charity, nor even by ritual can I be seen in this formas you have seen Me.
negative: He who sees Mepresent in all beings, and all beings existing within Me, never loses sight of Me, and I never lose sight of him.

query: भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्य अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन |ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परन्तप |
positive: Through single-minded devotion, however, I can be seen in this form; nay, known in essence and even entered into, O valiant Arjuna.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः |निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव |
positive: Arjuna, he who performs all his duties for My sake, depends on Me, is devoted to Me; has no attachment, and is free from malice towards all beings, reaches Me.
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: अर्जुन उवाच |एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते |ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः |
positive: Arjuna said: The devotees who, with their minds constantly fixed on You as shown above, adore You as possessed of form and attributes, and those who adore as the supreme Reality
negative: Therefore, Arjuna, he whose senses are restrained in all respects from their objects, his intelligence is firmly established.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते |श्रद्धया परयोपेताः ते मे युक्ततमा मताः |
positive: Shree Bhagavan said: I consider them to be the best Yogis, who endowed with supreme faith, and ever united through meditation with Me, worship Me with the mind centred on Me.
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: सन्नियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः |ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः |
positive: Having restrained all the senses, even-minded everywhere, intent on the welfare of all beings verily they also come unto Me
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः |अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते |
positive: On the other hand, those who depending exclusively on Me, and surrendering all actions to Me, worship Me, constantly meditating on Me with single-minded devotion.
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात् |भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम् |
positive: These, Arjuna, I speedily deliver from the ocean of birth and death, their mind being fixed on Me.
negative: In order to shower My grace on them I, dwelling in their heart, dispel the darkness born of ignorance by the shining light of wisdom.

query: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय |निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः |
positive: Therefore, fix your mind on Me, and establish your intellect in Me alone; thereafter you will abide solely in Me. There is no doubt about it.
negative: Since I have no craving for the fruit of actions; actions do not contaminate Me, Even he who thus knows Me in reality is not bound by actions.

query: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम् |अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय |
positive: If you cannot steadily fix the mind on Me, Arjuna, then seek to attain Me through the Yoga of repeated practice.
negative: Since I have no craving for the fruit of actions; actions do not contaminate Me, Even he who thus knows Me in reality is not bound by actions.

query: अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव |मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि |
positive: If You are unequal even to the pursuit of such practice, be intent to work for Me; you shall attain perfectioneven by performing actions for My sake.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः |सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान् |
positive: If, taking recourse to the Yoga of My realization, you are unable even to do this, then, subduing your mind and intellect etc., relinquish the fruit of all actions.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च |निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी |
positive: He who is free from malice towards all beings, friendly and compassionate, rid of 'I' and 'mine', balanced in pleasure and pain, forgiving—such a devotee is dear to Me
negative: He who has given up all desires, and moves free from attachment, egoism and thirst for enjoyment attains peace.

query: सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः |मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः |
positive: Contented, ever steadfast in yoga, self-controlled, firm in determination, with mind and intellect dedicated to Me, he is dear to Me.
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः |हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः |
positive: He who is not a source of annoyance to his fellow-creatures, and who in his turn does not feel vexed with fellow-creatures, and who is free from delight and envy perturbation and fear, is dear to Me.
negative: Those who are vowed to gods go to the gods; those who are vowed to the manes reach the manes; those who adore the spirits reach the spirits and those who worship Me come to Me alone..

query: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति |शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान्यः स मे प्रियः |
positive: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves, nor desires and who renounces both good and evil actions and is full of devotion, is dear to Me.
negative: He who is not a source of annoyance to his fellow-creatures, and who in his turn does not feel vexed with fellow-creatures, and who is free from delight and envy perturbation and fear, is dear to Me.

query: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः |शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः |
positive: He who is alike to friend and foe, as well as to honour and ignominy, who remains balanced in heat and cold, pleasure and pain and other contrary experiences, and is free from attachment.
negative: The faithful, the devoted, and the self-controlled attain knowledge; having obtained knowledge, they soon reach supreme peace.

query: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येन केनचित् |अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः |
positive: He who takes praise and reproach alike, and is given to contemplation and contented with any means of subsistence whatsoever, entertaining no sense of ownership and attachment in respect of his dwelling place and full of devotion to Me, that man is dear to Me.
negative: One who, having obtained the beloved, does not rejoice, and having obtained the unlovely, is not disturbed; that steady-minded, unbewildered knower of Brahman is ever established in the One Supreme Spirit.

query: ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते |श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः |
positive: Those devotees, however, who partake in a disinterested way of this nectar of pious wisdom set forth above, endowed with faith and solely devoted to Me, they are extremely dear to me.
negative: Endowed with such faith he worship that particular deity and obtains through him without doubt his desired enjoyments as ordained by Myself.

query: अर्जुन उवाच |प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च |एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव |
positive: Arjuna said I wish to learn about Natureand the Spirit, the field and the knower of the field, knowledge and that which ought to be known, O Keshava
negative: Sri Bhagavan said: This body, Arjuna, is termed as the Field; and him who knows it, the sages discerning the truth about both refer to as the knower of the Field.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते |एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः |
positive: Sri Bhagavan said: This body, Arjuna, is termed as the Field; and him who knows it, the sages discerning the truth about both refer to as the knower of the Field.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत |क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम |
positive: Know Myself to be the Ksetrajñaalso in all the Ksetras, Arjuna. And it is the knowledge of Ksetra and Ksetrajñawhich I consider as Wisdom.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक्च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत् |स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे शृणु |
positive: What that Ksetra is and what it is like; and also what are its evolutes, again, whence is what, and also finally who that Ksetrajna is and what is his glory—hear all this from Me in a nutshell.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: महाभूतान्यहंकारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च |इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः |
positive: The five elements, the ego, the intellect, the Unmanifest, the ten organs, the mind, and the five objects of sense;—
negative: And the excellent archer, the King of Kasi and Sikhandi the Maharathi,

query: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं संघातश्चेतना धृतिः |एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम् |
positive: Also desire, aversion, pleasure, pain the physical body, consciousness, firmness: thus is the Ksetra, with its evolutes, briefly states.
negative: He who is able to endure the force of desire and anger born of the mind before the destruction of the body, he is a yogi and he is happy.

query: अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम् |आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः |
positive: Absence of pride, freedom from hypocrisy, non-violence, forbearance, straightness of body, speech and mind, devout service of the preceptor, internal and external purity, steadfastness of mind and control of body, mind and the senses.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहंकार एव च |जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम् |
positive: Dispassion towards the objects of the senses, absence of ego, and contemplation of the miseries born of birth, death, old age, disease and faults.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी |विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि |
positive: Devotion to Me, which is unwavering by other engagements, residing in a secluded place, free from material desires, and without love for the society of materialistic persons;
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् |एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोऽन्यथा |
positive: Fixity in self-knowledge and seeing God as the object of true knowledge, all this is declared as knowledge; and what is other than this is called ignorance.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते |अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते |
positive: That which is to be known, which when known one attains immortality, is the beginningless supreme Brahman; there is nothing like it anywhere. I shall speak to you at length about that which ought to be known, and knowing which one attains supreme Bliss. That supreme Brahma, who is the lord of beginning less entities, is said to be neither Satnor Asat.
negative: For, I am the ground of the imperishable Brahma, of immortality, of the eternal virtue and of unending immutable bliss.

query: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् |सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति |
positive: It has hands and feet on all sides, eyes, head and mouth in all directions, and ears all round; for it stands pervading all in the universe.
negative: Having restrained all the senses, even-minded everywhere, intent on the welfare of all beings verily they also come unto Me

query: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् |असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च |
positive: Though perceiving all sense-objects it is, really speaking, devoid of all senses. Nay, though unattached, it is the sustainer of all nonetheless; and though attributeless, it is the enjoyer of qualities.
negative: He who is unattached to everything, and meeting with good and evil, neither rejoices nor recoils, his mind is stable.

query: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च |सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत् |
positive: It exists without and within all beings, and constitutes the animate and inanimate creation as well. And by reason of Its subtlety, It is incomprehensible; it is close at hand and stand afar too.
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम् |भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च |
positive: Though integral like space in its undivided aspect. It appears divided as it were in all animate and inanimate beings. And that godhead, which is the only object worth knowing, is the sustainer of beings, the destroyerand the creator of all.
negative: The seers whose sins have been wiped out, whose doubts have been dispelled by Knowledge, whose disciplined mind is firmly established in God and who are actively engaged in the service of all beings, attain Brahma, who is all peace.

query: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते |ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम् |
positive: That is the light of all lights, beyond darkness; it is knowledge, the object of knowledge, and the goal of knowledge, the most subtle of all.
negative: And, Arjuna, Knowledge stand covered by this eternal enemy of the wise, known as desire, which is insatiable like fire.

query: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः |मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते |
positive: Thus the truth of the Ksetra and knowledge, as well as of the object worth knowing, God has been briefly discussed; knowing this in reality, My devotee enters into My Being.
negative: I shall unfold to you in its entirety this wisdomalong with the Knowledge of the qualified aspect of God, having known which nothing else remains yet to be known in this world.

query: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि |विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसम्भवान् |
positive: Prakrti and Purusha, know both these as beginningless, and know all modifications such as likes and dislikes etc. and all objects constituted of the three Gunas as born of Prakrti.
negative: God determines not the doership nor the doings of men, nor even their contact with the fruit of actions; but it is Nature alone that functions.

query: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते |पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते |
positive: Prakrti is said to be responsible for bringing forth the evolutes and the instruments; while the individual soul is declared to be the cause of experience of joys and sorrows.
negative: All beings are evolved from food; production of food is dependent on rain; rain ensues from sacrifice.

query: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैः सह |सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते |
positive: He who thus knows the Purushaand Prakrtitogether with the Gunas,—even though performing his duties in every way, is never born again.
negative: Having subdued his mind and body, and given up all objects of enjoyment, and free from craving; he who performs sheer bodily actions, does not incur sin.

query: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना |अन्ये साङ्ख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे |
positive: Some by meditation behold the supreme Spirit in the heart with the help of their refined and sharp intellect; others realize It through the discipline of Knowledge, and others again, through the discipline of Action.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम् |क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ |
positive: Arjuna, whatsoever being, animate or inanimate, is born, know it as emanated from the union of Ksetraand the ksetrajña.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् |विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति |
positive: He alone truly sees, who sees the supreme Lord as imperishable and abiding equally in all perishable beings, both animate and inanimate
negative: Those who are vowed to gods go to the gods; those who are vowed to the manes reach the manes; those who adore the spirits reach the spirits and those who worship Me come to Me alone..

query: समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम् |न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम् |
positive: For, he who kills not himself by himself be seeing the supreme Lord, equally present in all, as one, thereby reaches the supreme state.
negative: He who sees Mepresent in all beings, and all beings existing within Me, never loses sight of Me, and I never lose sight of him.

query: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति |तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा |
positive: The moment man perceives the diversified existence of beings as rooted in the one supreme Spirit, and the spreading forth of all beings from the same, that very moment he attains Brahma.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः |शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते |
positive: O Arjuna! Being without beginning and devoid of qualities, this imperishable Supreme Soul, though residing in the body, neither acts nor is affected.
negative: In this world that great soul has no use whatsoever for things done nor for things not done; nor has he selfish dependence of any kind on any creature.

query: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः |क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत |
positive: O Arjuna! Just as the one sun illuminates the entire world, in the same way, the one Self illuminates the entire field.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा |\nभूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्
positive: Arjuna, as the one sun illumines this entire universe, so the one Atmaillumines the whole Ksetra.
negative: They, however, who, finding fault with this teaching of Mine, do not follow it, take those fools to be deluded in the matter of all knowledge, and lost.

query: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः |सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च |
positive: Those who, by practising this wisdom, have entered into My Being are not born again at the cosmic dawn nor feel disturbed even during the cosmic night.
negative: They, however, who, finding fault with this teaching of Mine, do not follow it, take those fools to be deluded in the matter of all knowledge, and lost.

query: मम योनिर्महद् ब्रह्म तस्मिन्गर्भं दधाम्यहम् |सम्भवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत |
positive: My primordial Nature, known as the great Brahman, is the womb from which all beings are born, O Bharata. I place the seed of consciousness in that womb, and from the union of the inert and the conscious, all beings come into existence.
negative: For, I am the ground of the imperishable Brahma, of immortality, of the eternal virtue and of unending immutable bliss.

query: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः |तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता |
positive: Of all embodied beings that appear in all the species of various kinds Arjuna, Prakrti, or Nature is the conceiving Mother, while I am the seed-giving Father.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः |निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम् |
positive: Sattva, Rajas and Tamas—these three qualities born of Prakriti bind the imperishable soul to the body, O mighty-armed Arjuna.
negative: And the excellent archer, the King of Kasi and Sikhandi the Maharathi,

query: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम् |सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ |
positive: Of these Sattva, being immaculate, is illuminating and flawless, Arjuna; it binds through identification with joy and wisdom.
negative: Fixity in self-knowledge and seeing God as the object of true knowledge, all this is declared as knowledge; and what is other than this is called ignorance.

query: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम् |तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम् |
positive: Know that Rajas, which is passionate, born of desire and attachment, O son of Kunti, binds the embodied soul by attachment to actions and their fruits.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत |ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत |
positive: Sattva, O Bharata, is engaged in happiness; Rajas in action; and Tamas, born of ignorance, deludes all beings by causing error.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च |तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन |
positive: With the growth of Tamas, Arjuna, obtuseness of the mind and senses, disinclination to perform one’s obligatory duties, frivolity and stupor—all these appear.
negative: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves, nor desires and who renounces both good and evil actions and is full of devotion, is dear to Me.

query: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत् |तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते |
positive: When a man dies during the preponderance of Sattva, he obtains the stainless ethereal worldattained by men of noble deeds.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते |तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते |
positive: Dying when Rajas predominates, he is born among those attached to action; even so the man who has expired during the preponderance of Tamas is reborn in the species of stupid creatures, such as insects, and beasts etc.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम् |रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम् |
positive: The reward of a righteous act, they say, is Sattvika and faultless; sorrow is declared to be the fruit of a Rajasika act and ignorance, the fruit of a Tamasika act.
negative: O creator of beings, O Ruler of creatures, O God of gods, the Lord of the universe, O supreme Purusha, You alone know what You are by Yourself.

query: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च |प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च |
positive: Wisdom follows from Sattva, and greed, undoubtedly, from Rajas, likewise obstinate error, stupor and also ignorance follow from Tamas.
negative: Thus the truth of the Ksetra and knowledge, as well as of the object worth knowing, God has been briefly discussed; knowing this in reality, My devotee enters into My Being.

query: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः |जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः |
positive: Those established in Sattva ascend upwards; those in Rajas remain in the middle; and those in Tamas go downwards.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति |गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति |
positive: When the seer perceives no agent other than the three Gunas; and realizes Me, the supreme Spirit standing entirely beyond these Gunas, he enters into My Being.
negative: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves, nor desires and who renounces both good and evil actions and is full of devotion, is dear to Me.

query: गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान् |जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते |
positive: Having transcended the aforesaid three Gunas, which have caused the body, and freed from birth, death, old age and all kinds of sorrow, this soul attains supreme bliss.
negative: Freed from these three gates of hell, man works his own salvation and thereby attains the supreme goal i.e., God.

query: अर्जुन उवाच |कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो |किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते |
positive: Arjuna said: What are the marks of him who has risen above the three Gunas, and what is his conduct? And how, Lord, does he rise above the three Gunas?
negative: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, now I shall tell you My conspicuous divine glories; for there is no limit to My magnitude.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव |न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति |
positive: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, he who hates not lightand activityand even stupor, when prevalent, nor longs for them when they have ceased.
negative: Arjuna, My birth and activities are divine. he who knows this in reality is not reborn on leaving his body, but comes to Me.

query: उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते |गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येवं योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते |
positive: He who is indifferent to the modes of nature, and who remains unshaken, knowing that the modes act on the modes, remains established in the Self and is never shaken.
negative: Man does not attain freedom from actionwithout entering upon action; nor does he reach perfectionmerely by ceasing to act.

query: समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः |तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः |
positive: He who is ever established in the Self, takes woe and joy alike, regards a clod of earth, a stone and a piece of gold as equal in value, is possessed of wisdom, perceives the pleasant as well as the unpleasant in the same spirit, and views censure and praise alike.
negative: The faithful, the devoted, and the self-controlled attain knowledge; having obtained knowledge, they soon reach supreme peace.

query: मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः |सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते |
positive: He who is indifferent to honour and ignominy; is alike to the cause of a friend as well as to that of an enemy, and has renounced the senses of doership in all undertakings, is said to have risen above the three Gunas.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते |स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान्ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते |
positive: He too who constantly worships Me through the Yoga of exclusive devotion,—transcending these three Gunas, becomes eligible for attaining Brahma.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च |शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च |
positive: For, I am the ground of the imperishable Brahma, of immortality, of the eternal virtue and of unending immutable bliss.
negative: And the excellent archer, the King of Kasi and Sikhandi the Maharathi,

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम् |छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित् |
positive: Shree Bhagavan said: He who knows the pipal tree; which is said to be imperishable, having its root above and branches below, and whose leaves are the Vedas—he alone knows the Vedas.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखागुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः |अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानिकर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके |
positive: Fed by the three Gunas and having sense-objects for their tender leaves, the branches of the aforesaid treeextend both downwards and upwards; and its roots, which bind the soul according to its action in the human body, are spread in all regions, higher as well as lower.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यतेनान्तो न चादिर्न च सम्प्रतिष्ठा |अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूलंअसङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा |
positive: The nature of this tree of creation does not on mature thought turn out what it is represented to be; for it has neither beginning nor end, nor even stability. Therefore, felling this Pipal tree, which is most firmly rooted, with the formidable axe of dispassion.
negative: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves, nor desires and who renounces both good and evil actions and is full of devotion, is dear to Me.

query: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषाअध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः |द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञैर्-गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत् |
positive: Those who have conquered pride, attachment, and faults, who are always spiritual, who have renounced desires, who are free from dualities of pleasure and pain, who are free from delusion, and who are established in the imperishable state.
negative: He who has given up all desires, and moves free from attachment, egoism and thirst for enjoyment attains peace.

query: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः |यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम |
positive: Neither the sun nor the moon nor even fire can illumine that supreme self-effulgent state, attaining to which they never return to this world. That is My supreme Abode.
negative: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves, nor desires and who renounces both good and evil actions and is full of devotion, is dear to Me.

query: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः |मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति |
positive: The eternal Jivatma in this body is a particle of My own being; and it is that alone which draws round itself the mind and the five senses, which rest in Prakrti.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः |गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात् |
positive: As the wind carries the scent from its source, so the living entity, who is the master of the body, leaves one body and takes hold of the senses with the mind and enters another body.
negative: He who is able to endure the force of desire and anger born of the mind before the destruction of the body, he is a yogi and he is happy.

query: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च |अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते |
positive: It is while dwelling in the senses of hearing, sight, touch, taste and smell, as well as in the mind, Jivatma enjoys the objects of senses.
negative: It has hands and feet on all sides, eyes, head and mouth in all directions, and ears all round; for it stands pervading all in the universe.

query: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम् |यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम् |
positive: The light in the sun, that illumines the entire solar world, and that which shines in the moon and that too which shines in the fire, know that light to be Mine.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा |पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः |
positive: And permeating the soil, it is I who support all creatures by My vital power; and becoming the nectarine moon, I nourish all pllants.
negative: Arjuna, during the Final Dissolution all beings enter My Prakrti, and at the beginning of creation, I send them forth again.

query: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः |प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम् |
positive: Taking the form of fire lodged in the body of all creatures and united with the Pranaand Apanabreaths, it is I who consume the four kinds of food.
negative: Arjuna I am the universal Self seated in the heart of all beings; so I alone am the beginning and middle and also the end of all beings.

query: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टोमत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनञ्च |वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्योवेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम् |
positive: I am seated in the hearts of all; I am the beginning, the middle and the end of knowledge. I am memory, knowledge and forgetfulness. I am indeed the knower of the Vedas, and the author of Vedanta, and the remover of doubts.
negative: Having restrained all the senses, even-minded everywhere, intent on the welfare of all beings verily they also come unto Me

query: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च |क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते |
positive: The perishable and the imperishable too—these are the two kinds of Purushas in this world. Of these, the bodies of all beings are spoken of as the perishable; while the jivatma or the embodied soul is called imperishable.
negative: It has hands and feet on all sides, eyes, head and mouth in all directions, and ears all round; for it stands pervading all in the universe.

query: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युधाहृतः |यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः |
positive: The Supreme Person is yet other than these, who, having entered all the three worlds, upholds and maintains all, and has been spoken of as the imperishable Lord and the supreme Spirit.
negative: And the excellent archer, the King of Kasi and Sikhandi the Maharathi,

query: यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः |अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः |
positive: Since I am wholly beyond the perishable world of matter of Ksetra, and am superior even to the imperishable soul, hence I am well known in the world and in the Vedas as the Supreme Person.
negative: O best of the Bharatas, I am the strength of the strong, devoid of desire and passion; and I am the desire in beings, not opposed to dharma.

query: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयानघ |एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत |
positive: Arjuna, this most esoteric teaching has thus been imparted by Me; grasping it in essence man becomes wise and his mission in life is accomplished.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: श्रीभगवानुवाच |अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः |दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम् |
positive: Absolute fearlessness, perfect purity of mind; constant fixity in the Yoga of meditation for the sake of Self-Realization, and even so charity in its Sattvika form, control of the senses, worship of god and other deities as well as of one’s elders including the performance of Agnihotraand other sacred duties, study and teaching of the Vedas and other sacred books as well as the chanting of God’s names and praises, suffering hardships for the discharge of one’s sacred obligations and straightness of mind as well as of the body and senses.
negative: Arjuna, My birth and activities are divine. he who knows this in reality is not reborn on leaving his body, but comes to Me.

query: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः |कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत् |
positive: Desire, anger and greed— this triple gate of hell brings about the ruination of the soul. Therefore, one should, avoid all these three.

positive: Freed from these three gates of hell, man works his own salvation and thereby attains the supreme goal i.e., God.

positive: Arjuna said: Those who endowed with faith, worship gods and others casting aside the injunctions of the scriptures, where do they stand, Krishna,— in Sattva, Rajas or Tamas?

positive: Shree Bhagavan said: that untutored innate faith of men is of three kinds—Sattvika and Rajasika and Tamasika. Hear of it from Me.

positive: Men of a Sattvika disposition worship gods; those of Rajasika temperament worship demigods and demons; while others, who are men of a Tamasika disposition, worship the spirits of the dead and groups of ghosts.

positive: And who emaciate the elements constituting their body as well as Me, the supreme Spirit, dwelling in their heart,—know these senseless people to have a demoniac disposition.

positive: Foods which promote longevity, intelligence, vigour, health, happiness and cheerfulness, and which are sweet, bland, substantial and naturally agreeable, are dear to the Sattvika type of men.

positive: Foods which are bitter, acid, salty, overhot, pungent, dry and burning, and which cause suffering, grief and sickness, are dear to the Rajasika type of men.

positive: Food which is half-cooked or half-ripe, insipid, putrid, stale and polluted, and which is impure too, is dear to men a Tamasika disposition.
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

positive: The sacrifice which is offered, as ordained by scriptural injunctions, by men who expect no return and who believe that such sacrifices must be performed, is Sattvika in character.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

positive: Worship of gods, the Brahmanas, one’s elders and wise men, purity, straightness, continence and harmlessness—this is called bodily penance.

positive: Words which cause no annoyance to others and are truthful, agreeable and wholesome, as well as the study of the Vedas and other Sastras and the practice of repetition of the Divine Name—this is known as the austerity of speech.
negative: Thus the truth of the Ksetra and knowledge, as well as of the object worth knowing, God has been briefly discussed; knowing this in reality, My devotee enters into My Being.

positive: This threefold penance performed with supreme faith by Yogis expecting no return is called Sattvika.

positive: The penance which is performed for the sake of show, honor, and worship, or for any other selfish purpose, either by nature or hypocrisy, is said to be Rajasic, producing uncertain and temporary results.

positive: OM, TAT and SAT—This has been declared as the threefold appellation of the Absolute, who is Truth, Consciousness and Bliss solidified. By That the Brahmanas and the Vedas as well as sacrifices were created at the cosmic dawn.

positive: Therefore, acts of sacrifice, charity and austerity as enjoined by sacred precepts are always commenced by noble souls given to the recitation of Vedic chants with utterance of the divine name OM.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

positive: With the idea that all this belongs to that Supreme Being, various acts of sacrifice, austerity and charity are performed by men desiring welfare, without attachment to the fruits.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

positive: The name of God, SAT, is employed in the sense of truth and goodness. And the word SAT is also used in the sense of a praiseworthy act, Arjuna.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते |कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते |
positive: And the steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity, and charity is also called 'Sat,' and action done for the sake of the Supreme is also designated as 'Sat'.
