query: अर्जुन उवाच |संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम् |त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन |
positive: Arjuna said: O mighty-armed Shree Krishna, O inner controller of all, O Slayer of Kesi, I wish to know severally the truth of Samnyasa and Tyaga.

positive: Shree Bhagavan said: Some sages understand Samnyasa as the giving up of all actions motivated by desire; and other thinkers declare that Tyaga consists in relinquishing the fruit of all actions.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

positive: Some wise men declare that all actions contain a measure of evil, and are therefore worth giving up, while others say that acts of sacrifice, charity and penance are not to be given up.
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: निश्चयं शृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम |त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः सम्प्रकीर्तितः |
positive: Of Samnyasa and Tyaga, first hear My conclusion on the subject of Tyaga, Arjuna; for Tyaga, O tiger among men, has been declared to be of three kinds—Sattvika, Rajasika and Tamasika.

negative: If You are unequal even to the pursuit of such practice, be intent to work for Me; you shall attain perfectioneven by performing actions for My sake.

query: न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते |त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः |
positive: One who does not look with desire upon the unskilled work and is not attached to the skilled work, that man is a true renunciant, endowed with pure goodness, free from doubt, and wise.
negative: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves, nor desires and who renounces both good and evil actions and is full of devotion, is dear to Me.

query: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः |यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते |
positive: Since all actions cannot be given up in their entirety by anyone possessing a body, he alone who renounces the fruit of actions is called a man of renunciation.
negative: Man does not attain freedom from actionwithout entering upon action; nor does he reach perfectionmerely by ceasing to act.

query: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम् |भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित् |
positive: Welcome, unwelcome and mixed-threefold, indeed, is the fruit that accrues hereafter from the actions of the unrenouncing. But there is none ever for those who have renounced.
negative: Having subdued his mind and body, and given up all objects of enjoyment, and free from craving; he who performs sheer bodily actions, does not incur sin.

query: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम् |विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम् |
positive: The following are the factors operating towards the accomplishment of actions, viz., the seat of action and the agent, the organs of different kinds and the separate movements of divergent types; and the fifth is Daiva or destiny.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः |न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः |
positive: These five are the contributory causes of whatever actions, right or wrong man performs with the mind, speech and body.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः |पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः |
positive: Notwithstanding this, however, he who, having an impure mind, regards the absolute, taintless Self alone as the doer, that man of perverse understanding does not view aright.
negative: He, however, who takes delight in the self alone and is gratified with the Self, and is contented in the self, has no duty.

query: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते |हत्वाऽपि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते |
positive: He whose mind is free from the sense of doership, and whose reason is not tainted by worldly objects and activities, does not really slay, even having slaughtered all these creatures, nor is bound by sin.
negative: Since I have no craving for the fruit of actions; actions do not contaminate Me, Even he who thus knows Me in reality is not bound by actions.

query: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना |करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः |
positive: The knower, knowledge and the object of knowledge—these three are the causes of action; the agent, the instrument and the action—these three constitute the collection of actions.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ताच त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः |प्रोच्यते गुणसङ्ख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि |
positive: In the branch of knowledge dealing with the Gunas or modes of Prakrti, knowledge and action as well as the doer have been declared to be of three kinds according to the Guna which predominates in each; hear them too duly from Me.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते |अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम् |
positive: That by which man perceives one imperishable divine existence as undivided and equally present in all individual beings, know that knowledge to be Sattvika.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान् |वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम् |
positive: That, however, by which man cognize many existences of various kinds as apart from one another in all beings, know that knowledge to be Rajasika.
negative: I shall unfold to you in its entirety this wisdomalong with the Knowledge of the qualified aspect of God, having known which nothing else remains yet to be known in this world.

query: यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम् |अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् |
positive: Again, that knowledge which clings to one body as if it were the whole, and which is irrational, has no real object and is trivial, has been declared as Tamasika.
negative: If You are unequal even to the pursuit of such practice, be intent to work for Me; you shall attain perfectioneven by performing actions for My sake.

query: नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम् |अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते |
positive: That action which is ordained by the scriptures and is not accompanied by the sense of doership, and has been done without any partiality or prejudice by one who seeks no return, is called Sattvika.
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहंकारेण वा पुनः |क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम् |
positive: That action, however, which involves much strain and is performed by one who seeks enjoyments or by a man full of egotism, has been spoken of as Rajasika.
negative: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves, nor desires and who renounces both good and evil actions and is full of devotion, is dear to Me.

query: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम् |मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते |
positive: That action which is undertaken through sheer ignorance, without counting the upshot, loss to oneself, injury to others and one’s own capacity, is declared as Tamasika.
negative: All his actions melt away, who is free from attachment, whose mind is established in knowledge, and who performs actions for the sake of sacrifice.

query: मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः |सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते |
positive: Free from attachment, unegoistic, endowed with firmness and vigour and unswayed by success and failure—such a doer is said to be Sattvika.
negative: Man does not attain freedom from actionwithout entering upon action; nor does he reach perfectionmerely by ceasing to act.

query: अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः |विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते |
positive: Lacking piety and self-control, uncultured, arrogant, deceitful, inclined to rob others of their livelihood, slothful, down-hearted and procrastinating, such a doer is called Tamasika.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये |बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी |
positive: The intellect which correctly determines the paths of activity and renunciation, what ought to be done and what should not be done, what is fear and what is fearlessness, and what is bondage and what is liberation, that intellect is Sattvika.
negative: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves, nor desires and who renounces both good and evil actions and is full of devotion, is dear to Me.

query: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च |अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी |
positive: By which a person knows what is duty and what is not duty, what is action and what is inaction, that intellect, O Partha, is Rajasic. The intellect by which man does not truly perceive what is Dharma and what is Adharma, what ought to be done and what should not be done,—that intellect is Rajasika.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसावृता |सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी |
positive: The intellect which imagines even Adharma to be Dharma, and sees all other things upside-down,—wrapped in ignorance, that intellect is Tamasika, Arjuna.
negative: He who is unattached to everything, and meeting with good and evil, neither rejoices nor recoils, his mind is stable.

query: धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः |योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी |
positive: The unwavering firmness by which man controls through the Yoga of meditation the functions of the mind, the vital airs and the senses—that firmness, Arjuna, is Sattvika.
negative: He who is able to endure the force of desire and anger born of the mind before the destruction of the body, he is a yogi and he is happy.

query: यया तु धर्मकामार्थान्धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन |प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी |
positive: The Dhrti, however, by which the man seeking a reward for his actions, clutches with extreme fondness virtues, earthly possessions and worldly enjoyments,—that Dhrti is Rajasika, Arjuna.
negative: Endowed with such faith he worship that particular deity and obtains through him without doubt his desired enjoyments as ordained by Myself.

query: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च |न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी |
positive: The firmness by which a foolish person does not give up sleep, fear, grief, despondency, and pride — that firmness, O Partha, is Tāmasika
negative: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race

query: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ |अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति |
positive: Now hear from Me the threefold joy too. That is which the striver finds enjoyments through practice of adoration, meditation and service to God etc., and whereby he reaches the end of sorrow.
negative: He who is able to endure the force of desire and anger born of the mind before the destruction of the body, he is a yogi and he is happy.

query: यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः |निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् |
positive: That which stupefies the self during its enjoyment as well as in the end, derived from sleep, indolence and obstinate error; such delight has been called Tamasika.
negative: He who is able to endure the force of desire and anger born of the mind before the destruction of the body, he is a yogi and he is happy.

query: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परन्तप |कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः |
positive: The duties of the Brahmanas, the Ksatriyas and the Vaisyas, as well as of the Sudras, have been divided according to their inborn qualities, Arjuna.
negative: And the excellent archer, the King of Kasi and Sikhandi the Maharathi,

query: शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम् |दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम् |
positive: Exhibition of valour, fearlessness, firmness, cleverness and steadiness in battle, bestowing gifts, and lordliness—all these constitute the natural duty of a Ksatriya.
negative: The devotees who worship the gods with faith and perform sacrifices, they also worship Me, O son of Kunti, performing their duties in the prescribed manner.

query: कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम् |परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम् |
positive: Agriculture, rearing of cows and honest exchange of merchandise—these constitute the natural duty of a Vaisya. And service of the other classes in the natural duty of a Sudra.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् |स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् |
positive: Better is one’s own duty, though devoid of merit, than the duty of another well-performed; for performing the duty ordained by his own nature man does not incur sin.
negative: Having subdued his mind and body, and given up all objects of enjoyment, and free from craving; he who performs sheer bodily actions, does not incur sin.

query: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः |नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति |
positive: He whose intellect is unattached everywhere, whose thirst for enjoyments has altogether disappeared and who has subdued his mind, reaches through Sankhyayogathe consummation of actionlessness.
negative: Having restrained all the senses, even-minded everywhere, intent on the welfare of all beings verily they also come unto Me

query: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्यात्मानं नियम्य च |शब्दादीन्विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च |
positive: Endowed with an untarnished intellect and partaking of a light, Sattvika and regulated diet, having rejected sound and other objects of sense, and having completely got rid of attraction and aversion.
negative: The faithful, the devoted, and the self-controlled attain knowledge; having obtained knowledge, they soon reach supreme peace.

query: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः |ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः |
positive: Living in a lonely and undefiled place, partaking of light food, controlling speech, body and mind, remaining ever devoted to meditation, taking constant recourse to dispassion.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् |विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते |
positive: Having given up egotism, strength, arrogance, desire, anger and possessions, devoid of ‘mineness,’ tranquil in heart, the man becomes qualified for oneness with Brahma.
negative: For, I am the ground of the imperishable Brahma, of immortality, of the eternal virtue and of unending immutable bliss.

query: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति |समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम् |
positive: Endowed with an untarnished intellect and partaking of a light, Sattvika and regulated diet, living in a lonely and undefiled place having rejected sound and other objects of sense, having controlled the mind, speech and body by restraining the mind and senses through firmness of a Sattvika type, taking a resolute stand on dispassion, after having completely got rid of attraction and aversion and remaining ever devoted to the Yoga of meditation having given up egotism, violence, arrogance, lust, anger and luxuries, devoid of the feeling of meum and tranquil of hear,—such a man becomes qualified for oneness with Brahma, who is Truth Consciousness and Bliss.
negative: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.

query: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः |ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् |
positive: Through that supreme devotion he comes to know Me in reality, what and how great I am; and thereby knowing Me in essence he forthwith enters into My being.
negative: Thus the truth of the Ksetra and knowledge, as well as of the object worth knowing, God has been briefly discussed; knowing this in reality, My devotee enters into My Being.

query: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः |मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् |
positive: The Karmayogi, however, who depends on Me, attains by My grace the eternal, imperishable state, even though performing all actions.
negative: Having restrained all the senses, even-minded everywhere, intent on the welfare of all beings verily they also come unto Me

query: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः |बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव |
positive: Mentally resigning all your duties to Me, and taking recourse to Yoga in the form of even-mindedness, be solely devoted to Me and constantly give your mind to Me.
negative: Having restrained all the senses, he should sit with his mind fixed on Me, devoted and controlling his senses; for the man who has his senses under control, his wisdom is firmly established.

query: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि |अथ चेत्त्वमहंकारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि |
positive: With your mind thus given to Me, you shall tide over all difficulties by My grace. And if, from egotism, you will not listen, you will be lost.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: यदहंकारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे |मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति |
positive: If you think, 'I will not fight,' taking shelter in egoism, your determination is false, for your nature will compel you to engage in battle.
negative: God determines not the doership nor the doings of men, nor even their contact with the fruit of actions; but it is Nature alone that functions.

query: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा |कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोपि तत् |
positive: That action too which you are not willing to undertake through ignorance,—bound by your own duty born of your nature, you will helplessly perform.
negative: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.

query: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति |भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया |
positive: The Supreme Lord is situated in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna, and is directing the wanderings of all living entities, who are seated as on a machine, made of the material energy.
negative: Arjuna I am the universal Self seated in the heart of all beings; so I alone am the beginning and middle and also the end of all beings.

query: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत |तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम् |
positive: Take shelter in Him alone, with all your being, Arjuna. By His mere grace you shall attain supreme peace and the eternal state.
negative: Therefore, You alone can describe in full Your divine glories, whereby You stand pervading all these worlds.

query: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया |विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु |
positive: Thus I have explained to you knowledge, more secret than all secrets. Reflect on this fully and then do as you wish.
negative: Through that supreme devotion he comes to know Me in reality, what and how great I am; and thereby knowing Me in essence he forthwith enters into My being.

query: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः |इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् |
positive: Hear, again, My supremely secret word, the most esoteric of all truths. You are extremely dear to Me; therefore, I shall offer you this salutary advice.
negative: This indeed is My lowernature; the other than this, by which the whole universe is sustained, know it to be My highernature in the form of Jiva, O Arjuna.

query: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु |मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे |
positive: Be devoted to Me, worship Me, bow down to Me. You shall come to Me alone; this is My promise to you. You are dear to Me. Give your mind to Me, be devoted to Me, worship Me and bow to Me. Doing so you will come to Me alone, I truly promise you; for you are exceptionally dear to Me.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन |न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति |
positive: This secret gospel of the Gita should never be imparted to a man who lacks penance, nor to him who is wanting in devotion, nor even to him who lends not a willing ear; and in no case to him who finds fault with Me.
negative: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves, nor desires and who renounces both good and evil actions and is full of devotion, is dear to Me.

query: य इदं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति |भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः |
positive: He who, offering the highest love to Me, preaches the most profound gospel of the gita among my devotees, shall come to me alone, there is no doubt about it.
negative: The Yogi who is established in union with Me, and worships Me as residing in all beings; abides in Me; no matter what he does.

query: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः |भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि |
positive: Among men there is none who does me a more loving service than he, nor shall anyone be dearer to me on the entire globe than he.
negative: In this world that great soul has no use whatsoever for things done nor for things not done; nor has he selfish dependence of any kind on any creature.

query: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः |ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः |
positive: Whosoever studies this sacred dialogue of ours in the form of the Gita, by him too shall I be worshipped through the sacrifice of knowledge—such is my opinion.
negative: Thus the truth of the Ksetra and knowledge, as well as of the object worth knowing, God has been briefly discussed; knowing this in reality, My devotee enters into My Being.

query: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः |सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् |
positive: The man who hears the holy Gita with reverence and in an uncarping spirit,—liberated from sin, he too shall reach the happy worlds of the virtuous.
negative: Even the wise call him a sage, whose undertaking are all free from desire and thoughts of the world, and whose actions are burnt up by the fire of wisdom.

query: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा |कच्चिदज्ञानसम्मोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय |
positive: O Partha, have you listened to this with concentrated mind? And O Dhananjaya, has your delusion born of ignorance been dispelled?
negative: O creator of beings, O Ruler of creatures, O God of gods, the Lord of the universe, O supreme Purusha, You alone know what You are by Yourself.

query: अर्जुन उवाच |नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत |स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव |
positive: Arjuna said: Krishna, by Your grace my delusion has fled and wisdom has been gained by me. I stand shorn of all doubts. I will do your bidding.
negative: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, hear once again My supreme word, which I shall speak to you, who are so loving, out of solicitude for your welfare.

query: सञ्जय उवाच |इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः |संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् |
positive: Sanjaya said: Thus I heard the mysterious and thrilling conversation between Shree Krishna and the high-souled Arjuna, son of Kunti.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम् |योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम् |
positive: Having been blessed with the divine vision by the grace of Shree Vyasa, I heard this supremely esoteric gospel from the Lord of Yoga, Shree Krishna Himself, imparting it to Arjuna before my very eyes.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम् |केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः |
positive: Remembering, over and over, that sacred and mystic conversation between Bhagavan Shree Krishna and Arjuna, O King! I rejoice again and yet again.
negative: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, hear once again My supreme word, which I shall speak to you, who are so loving, out of solicitude for your welfare.

query: तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः |विस्मयो मे महान् राजन्हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः |
positive: Remembering also, again and again, that most wonderful Form of Shree Krishna, great is my wonder and I rejoice over and over again.
negative: There he attains the union of intellect, born of the merits of past lives; and then he strives again, O Kurunandana, for perfection.

query: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः |तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम |
positive: Wherever there is Bhagavan Shree Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, and wherever there is Arjuna, the wielder of the Gandiva bow, goodness, victory, glory and unfailing righteousness are there: such is my conviction.
negative: O Lord, if You think that it is possible for me to behold that form by me, then show me that imperishable form, O Lord of Yoga.

query: Dhritarashtra said: Sanjaya, gathered on the sacred soil of Kurukshetra, eager to fight, what did my children and the children of Pandu do?
positive: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच |धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः |मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय |
negative: तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत |सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः |

query: Sanjaya said: At that time, seeing the army of the Pandavas drawn up for battle and approaching Dronacharya King Duryodhana spoke these words:
positive: सञ्जय उवाच |दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा |आचार्यमुपसंगम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत् |
negative: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच |धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः |मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय |

query: Behold, Master, the mighty army of the sons of Pandu arrayed for battle by your talented pupil, Dhristadyumna, son of Drupada.
positive: पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम् |व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता |
negative: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच |धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः |मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय |

query: The strong Yodhamanyu and the brave Uttamaujas, the son\nof Subhadra, and the sons of Draupadi, all of great chariots
positive: अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि |युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः |
negative: युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान् |सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः |

query: Dhrishtaketu, chekitana and the valiant king of Kasi, Purujit and Kuntibhoja and Saibya, the best men
positive: धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान् |पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुंगवः |
negative: काश्यश्च परमेष्वासः शिखण्डी च महारथः |धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः |

query: the best of men and mighty Yudhamanyu, and valiant Uttamauja, Abhimanyu, the son of Subhadra, and the five sons of Draupadi,—all of them Maharathis.
positive: युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान् |सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः |
negative: अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः |नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ |

query: Know also, O best among the twice-born! the names of those who are the most distinguished amongst ourselves, the leaders of my army; these I name to thee for thy information.
positive: अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम |नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते |
negative: एषा तेऽभिहिता साङ्ख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां शृणु |बुद्ध्या युक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि |

query: And there are many other heroes, equipped with various weapons and missiles, who have staked their lives for me, all skilled in warfare.
positive: अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः |नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः |
negative: अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम |नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते |

query: This army of ours, fully protected byBhishma, is unconquerable; while that army of theirs, guarded in every way by Bhima, is easy to conquer.
positive: अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम् |पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम् |
negative: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति |समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम् |

query: The grand old man of the Kaurava race, their glorious grand-uncle Bhishma, cheering up Duryodhana, roared terribly like a lion and blew his conch.
positive: तस्य सञ्जनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः |सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान् |
negative: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः |ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः |

query: Then conches kettledrums tabors, drums and trumpets suddenly blared forth and the noise was tumultuous.
positive: ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पणवानकगोमुखाः |सहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत् |
negative: श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति |शब्दादीन्विषयानन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति |

query: Then seated in a glorious chariot drawn by white horses, Shree Krishna as well as Arjuna blew their celestial conches.
positive: ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ |माधवः पाण्डवश्चैव दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः |
negative: तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत |सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः |

query: King Yudhisthira, son of Kunti, blew his conch Anantavijaya; while Nakula and Sahadeva blew theirs, known as Sughosa and Manipuspaka respectively.
positive: अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः |नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ |
negative: धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथादर्शो मलेन च |यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम् |

query: And the excellent archer, the King of Kasi and Sikhandi the Maharathi,
positive: काश्यश्च परमेष्वासः शिखण्डी च महारथः |धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः |
negative: युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान् |सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः |

query: and the sons of Drupada and Draupadi, and the mighty-armed Subhadra's son Abhimanyu—all of them, O King, blew their respective conches separately.
positive: द्रुपदो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः पृथिवीपते |सौभद्रश्च महाबाहुः शङ्खान्दध्मुः पृथक्पृथक् |
negative: युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान् |सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः |

query: Then, seeing the arranged armies of the sons of Dhritarashtra, the one with the banner of Hanumantook up his bow, ready for battle. Now, O lord of the earth, seeing your sons arrayed against him, and when missiles were ready to be hurled, Arjuna, son of Pandu, took up his bow and then addressed the following words to Shree Krishna; Krishna, place my chariot between the two armies.
positive: अथ व्यवस्थितान्दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान् कपिध्वजः |प्रवृत्ते शस्त्रसम्पाते धनुरुद्यम्य पाण्डवः |हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्याजगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च |रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्तिसर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः |

query: And keep it there till I have carefully observed these warriors drawn up for battle, and have seen with whom I have to engage in this fight.
positive: यावदेतान्निरीक्षेऽहं योद्धुकामानवस्थितान् |कैर्मया सह योद्धव्यमस्मिन् रणसमुद्यमे |
negative: अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम |नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते |

query: Thus addressed, Hrishikesha, the son of Gudakesha, stationed the best chariot in the midst of the armies, sounding the war-cry.
positive: सञ्जय उवाच |एवमुक्तो हृषीकेशो गुडाकेशेन भारत |सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये स्थापयित्वा रथोत्तमम् |
negative: तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत |सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः |

query: At the head of all the kings, led by Bhishma and Drona, Arjuna, O son of Kunti, behold these Kurus gathered together
positive: भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम् |उवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान्समवेतान्कुरूनिति |
negative: श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि |तान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान् |

query: Now Arjuna saw stationed there in both the armies his uncles, grand-uncles and teachers, even great grand-uncles, maternal uncles, brothers and cousins, sons and nephews, and grand-nephews, even so friends, fathers-in-law and well-wishers as well.
positive: तत्रापश्यत्स्थितान्पार्थः पितॄनथ पितामहान् |आचार्यान्मातुलान्भ्रातॄन्पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सखींस्तथा |
negative: अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि |युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः |

query: Seeing all those relations present there, Arjuna was filled with deep compassion, and uttered these words in sadness..
positive: श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि |तान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान् |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते |ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः |

query: Arjuna said—O Krishna! Seeing my own kinsmen eager to fight, my limbs are weakening, my mouth is drying up, and my body is trembling with shivers and goosebumps.
positive: कृपया परयाविष्टो विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत् |अर्जुन उवाच |दृष्ट्वेमं स्वजनं कृष्ण युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम् |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः |अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति |

query: My mouth is drying up, my body shivers, and my hair stands on end.
positive: सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति |वेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते |
negative: आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् |प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः |

query: The bow, Gandiva, slips from my hand and my skin too burns all over; my brain is whirling, as it were, and I can stand no longer.
positive: गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात्त्वक्चैव परिदह्यते |न च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः |
negative: मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा |निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः |

query: And, Keshava, I see such omens of evil, nor do I see any good in killing my kinsmen in battle
positive: निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि केशव |न च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे |
negative: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया |शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा |

query: Krishna, I do not covet victory, nor kingdom nor pleasures. Govinda, of what use will kingdom, or luxuries, or even life be to us!
positive: न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च |किं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा |
negative: श्रीभगवानुवाच |प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव |न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति |

query: Those very persons for whose sake we covet the throne, luxuries and pleasures—are here arrayed on the battlefield, having renounced wealth and even life itself.
positive: येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च |त इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च |
negative: अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम् |यद्राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः |

query: Teachers, fathers, sons, grandfathers, maternal uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law and other relatives are also present here in battle.
positive: आचार्याः पितरः पुत्रास्तथैव च पितामहाः |मातुलाः श्वशुराः पौत्राः श्यालाः सम्बन्धिनस्तथा |
negative: अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः |नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः |

query: O Slayer of Madhu, I do not want to kill them, though they should slay me, even for the throne of the three worlds; how much the less from earthly lordship!
positive: एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन |अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते |
negative: त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत् |मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम् |

query: Krishna, how can we hope to be happy slaying the sons of Dhrtarastra; killing these desperadoes sin will surely take hold of us.
positive: निहत्य धार्तराष्ट्रान्नः का प्रीतिः स्याज्जनार्दन |पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान्हत्वैतानाततायिनः |
negative: कृपया परयाविष्टो विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत् |अर्जुन उवाच |दृष्ट्वेमं स्वजनं कृष्ण युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम् |

query: Therefore, Krishna, it does not behove us to kill our relations, the sons of Dhritarashtra. For how can we be happy after killing our own kinsmen?
positive: तस्मान्नार्हा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान्स्वबान्धवान् |स्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव |
negative: न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च |किं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा |

query: Even if these people, with minds blinded by greed; perceive no evil in destroying their own race
positive: यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः |कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम् |
negative: य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम् |उभौ तौ न विजानीतो नायं हन्ति न हन्यते |

query: With the preponderance of vice, Krishna, the women of the family become corrupt; and with the corruption of women, O descendant of Vrsni, there ensues an intermixture of castes.
positive: अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः |स्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय जायते वर्णसङ्करः |
negative: मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः |राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः |

query: Admixture of blood damns the destroyers of the race as well as the race itself. Deprived of the offerings of rice and waterthe manes of their race also fall.
positive: सङ्करो नरकायैव कुलघ्नानां कुलस्य च |पतन्ति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः |
negative: एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः |स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप |

query: Krishna, we hear that men who have lost their family traditions dwell in hell for an indefinite period of time.
positive: उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन |नरके नियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम (or नरकेऽनियतं) |
negative: वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्तिदंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि |केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषुसन्दृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः |

query: Oh what a pity! Though possessed of intelligence we have set our mind on the commission of a great sin in that due to lust
positive: अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम् |यद्राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः |
negative: श्रीभगवानुवाच |असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् |अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते |

query: It would be better for me if the sons of Dhritarashtra, armed with weapons, killed me in battle while I was unarmed and unresisting.
positive: यदि मामप्रतीकारमशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः |धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत् |
negative: अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप |अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि |

query: Thus addressed, Sanjaya, standing in the midst of the armies, sat down on the chariot’s seat, his mind overwhelmed with grief, and having set aside his bow and arrows.
positive: सञ्जय उवाच |एवमुक्त्वार्जुनः सङ्ख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् |विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः |
negative: तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत |सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः |

query: Sanjaya said: Shree Krishna then addressed the following words to Arjuna, who was as mentioned before overwhelmed with pity, whose eyes were filled with tears and agitated, and who was full of sorrow.
positive: सञ्जय उवाच |तं तथा कृपयाविष्टमश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणम् |विषीदन्तमिदं वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनः |
negative: सञ्जय उवाच |एवमुक्त्वार्जुनः सङ्ख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् |विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः |

query: Yield not to unmanliness, Arjuna; ill does it become you. Shaking off this paltry faint-heartedness stand up, O scorcher of enemies.
positive: क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते |क्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परन्तप |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्याजगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च |रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्तिसर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः |

query: Therefore, I consider it better not to kill these venerable teachers in this world, even if it means living on alms. For if I kill the teachers, I shall enjoy only the blood-stained wealth and pleasures of this world.
positive: गुरूनहत्वा हि महानुभावान्श्रेयो भोक्तुं भैक्ष्यमपीह लोके |हत्वार्थकामांस्तु गुरूनिहैवभुञ्जीय भोगान् रुधिरप्रदिग्धान् |
negative: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते |अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते |

query: Wo do not even know which is preferable for us—to fight or not to fight; nor do we know whether we shall win or whether they will conquer us. Those very sons of Dhrtarastra, killing whom we do not even wish to live, stand in the enemy ranks.
positive: न चैतद्विद्मः कतरन्नो गरीयोयद्वा जयेम यदि वा नो जयेयुः |यानेव हत्वा न जिजीविषामस्-तेऽवस्थिताः प्रमुखे धार्तराष्ट्राः |
negative: स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि |धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाच्छ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते |

query: With my very being tainted by the vice of faint-heartedness and my mind puzzled with regard to duty, I am asking you. Tell me that which is decidedly good; I am Your disciple. Pray instruct me, who have put myself into Your hands.
positive: कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावःपृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसम्मूढचेताः |यच्छ्रेयः स्यान्निश्चितं ब्रूहि तन्मेशिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम् |
negative: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः |बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव |

query: Then, O Dhritarashtra, Shree Krishna, as if smiling, addressed the following words to sorrowing Arjuna, in the midst of the two armies.
positive: तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत |सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव |स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम् |

query: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, you grieve over those who should not be grieved for, and yet speak like the learned; wise men do not sorrow over the dead or the living.
positive: श्रीभगवानुवाच |अशोच्यानन्वशोचस्त्वं प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषसे |गतासूनगतासूंश्च नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्याजगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च |रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्तिसर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः |

query: In fact, there was never a time when I was not, or when you or these kings were not. Nor is it a fact that hereafter we shall all cease to be.
positive: न त्वेवाहं जातु नासं न त्वं नेमे जनाधिपाः |न चैव न भविष्यामः सर्वे वयमतः परम् |
negative: देही नित्यमवध्योऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत |तस्मात्सर्वाणि भूतानि न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि |

query: Just as boyhood, youth and old age are attributed to the soul through this body, even so it attains another body. The wise man does not get deluded about this.
positive: देहिनोऽस्मिन्यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा |तथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिर्धीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति |
negative: सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद् बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् |वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः |

query: Arjuna, the wise man to whom pain and pleasure are the same, who is not disturbed by the contacts of the senses and their objects, is fit for immortality.
positive: यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ |समदुःखसुखं धीरं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते |ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः |

query: The unreal has no existence, and the real never ceases to be, the reality of both has thus been perceived by the seers of truth.
positive: नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः |उभयोरपि दृष्टोऽन्तस्त्वनयोस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः |
negative: स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि |धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाच्छ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते |

query: Know that alone to be imperishable, which pervades this universe; for no one has power to destroy this indestructible substance.
positive: अन्तवन्त इमे देहा नित्यस्योक्ताः शरीरिणः |अनाशिनोऽप्रमेयस्य तस्माद्युध्यस्व भारत |
negative: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते |अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते |

query: All these bodies pertaining to the imperishable, indefinable and eternal soul are spoken of as perishable; therefore, Arjuna, fight.
positive: य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम् |उभौ तौ न विजानीतो नायं हन्ति न हन्यते |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते |ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः |

query: The soul is never born nor dies; nor does it become only after being born. For it is unborn, eternal, everlasting and ancient; even though the body is slain, the soul is not.
positive: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः |अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणोन हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे |
negative: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः |शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते |

query: Arjuna, the man who knows this soul to be imperishable, eternal and free from birth and decay,—how and whom will he cause to be killed, how and whom will he kill?
positive: वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनमजमव्ययम् |कथं स पुरुषः पार्थ कं घातयति हन्ति कम् |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् |पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम् |

query: As a man shedding worn-out garments, takes other new ones, likewise the embodied soul, casting off worn-out bodies, enters into others which are new.
positive: वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहायनवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि |तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णा-न्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही |
negative: सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि |प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति |

query: Weapons cannot cut it, nor can fire burn it; water cannot wet it nor can wind dry it.
positive: नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः |न चैनं क्लेदयन्त्यापो न शोषयति मारुतः |
negative: स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि |धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाच्छ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते |

query: For this soul is incapable of being cut; it is proof against fire, impervious to water and undriable as well. This soul is eternal, omnipresent, immovable, constant and everlasting.
positive: अच्छेद्योऽयमदाह्योऽयमक्लेद्योऽशोष्य एव च |नित्यः सर्वगतः स्थाणुरचलोऽयं सनातनः |
negative: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते |अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते |

query: This soul is unmanifest; it is unthinkable; and it is spoken of as immutable. Therefore, knowing this as such, you should not grieve.
positive: अव्यक्तोऽयमचिन्त्योऽयमविकार्योऽयमुच्यते |तस्मादेवं विदित्वैनं नानुशोचितुमर्हसि |
negative: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते |अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते |

query: And, Arjuna, if you should suppose this soul to be subject to constant birth and death, even than you should not grieve like this.Hardly anyone perceives this soul as marvellous, scarce another likewise speaks thereof as marvellous, and scarce another hears of it as marvellous; while there are some who know it not even on hearing of it.
positive: अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम् |तथापि त्वं महाबाहो नैवं शोचितुमर्हसि |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्याजगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च |रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्तिसर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः |

query: For in that case death is certain for the born, and rebirth is inevitable for the dead. You should not, therefore, grieve over the inevitable.
positive: जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च |तस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः |कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति |

query: Arjuna, before birth beings are not manifest to our human senses; at death they return to the unmanifest. What is there to grieve about in such a state?
positive: अव्यक्तादीनि भूतानि व्यक्तमध्यानि भारत |अव्यक्तनिधनान्येव तत्र का परिदेवना |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः |कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति |

query: Hardly anyone perceives this soul as marvellous, scarce another likewise speaks thereof as marvellous, and scarce another hears of it as marvellous; while there are some who know it not even on hearing of it.
positive: आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्चिदेन-माश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्यः |आश्चर्यवच्चैनमन्यः शृणोतिश्रुत्वाप्येनं वेद न चैव कश्चित् |
negative: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना |अन्ये साङ्ख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे |

query: Arjuna, this soul dwelling in the bodies of all can never be slain; therefore, you should not mourn for anyone.
positive: देही नित्यमवध्योऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत |तस्मात्सर्वाणि भूतानि न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि |
negative: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः |अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणोन हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे |

query: Besides: considering your own duty too you should not waver; for there is nothing superior for a warrior than a righteous war.
positive: स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि |धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाच्छ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते |
negative: सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ |ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि |

query: Arjuna, happy are the Ksatriyas who get such an unsolicited opportunity for war; which opens the door to heaven.
positive: यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम् |सुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम् |
negative: सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ |ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि |

query: Now, if you refuse to fight this righteous war, then, shirking your duty and losing your reputation, you will incur sin.
positive: अथ चेत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि |ततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापमवाप्स्यसि |
negative: सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ |ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि |

query: Nay, people will also pour undying infamy on you; and infamy brought on a man enjoying popular esteem is worse than death.
positive: अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति तेऽव्ययाम् |सम्भावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते |
negative: यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ |समदुःखसुखं धीरं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते |

query: Die, and you will win heaven; conquer, and you enjoy sovereignty of the earth; therefore, stand up, Arjuna, determined to fight.
positive: हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम् |तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्याजगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च |रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्तिसर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः |

query: Treating alike victory and defeat, gain and loss, pleasure and pain, get ready for the fight, then; fighting thus you will not incur sin.
positive: सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ |ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि |
negative: यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः |समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते |

query: Arjuna, this attitude of mind has been declared to you in the knowledge yoga; now hear it in the karma yoga by which, being united with wisdom, you will thoroughly destroy the bondage of actions.
positive: एषा तेऽभिहिता साङ्ख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां शृणु |बुद्ध्या युक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते |ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः |

query: Arjuna, in this Yogathe intellect is determinate and directed singly towards one ideal; whereas the intellect of the undecidedwanders in all directions, after innumerable aims.
positive: व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन |बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम् |
negative: ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते |एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् |

query: Arjuna, those unwise ones who are devoted to the letter of the Vedas and argue that there is nothing beyond heaven, utter flowery speech.
positive: यामिमां पुष्पितां वाचं प्रवदन्त्यविपश्चितः |वेदवादरताः पार्थ नान्यदस्तीति वादिनः |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् |पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम् |

query: Those who are full of desires, whose goal is heaven, who cling to rebirth and the fruits of action, who delight in various ritualistic works aimed at enjoyment and power.
positive: कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा जन्मकर्मफलप्रदाम् |क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति |
negative: सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते |प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते |

query: Arjuna, the Vedas thus deal with evolutes of the three Gunas; viz., worldly enjoyments and the means of attaining such enjoyments; be thou indifferent to these enjoyments and their means, rising above pairs of opposites like pleasure and pain etc., established in the Eternal Existence, absolutely unconcerned about the supply of wants and the preservation of what has been already attained, and self-controlled.
positive: त्रैगुण्यविषया वेदा निस्त्रैगुण्यो भवार्जुन |निर्द्वन्द्वो नित्यसत्त्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान् |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्याजगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च |रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्तिसर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः |

query: A Brahmana, who has obtained enlightenment, has the same use for all the Vedas as one who stands at the brink of a sheet of water overflowing on all sides has for a small reservoir of water.
positive: यावानर्थ उदपाने सर्वतः सम्प्लुतोदके |तावान्सर्वेषु वेदेषु ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः |
negative: एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति |स्थित्वास्यामन्तकालेऽपि ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृच्छति |

query: Arjuna, perform your duties established in Yoga, renouncing attachment, and even-tempered in success and failure; evenness of temper is called Yoga.
positive: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय |सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते |
negative: युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु |युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा |

query: Far inferior is action performed with attachment, O Dhananjaya, compared with the yoga of wisdom. The wise seek refuge in wisdom, renouncing the fruits of action, for the ignorant are attached to the fruits.
positive: दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगाद्धनञ्जय |बुद्धौ शरणमन्विच्छ कृपणाः फलहेतवः |
negative: युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु |युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा |

query: For wise men possessing an equipo­sied mind, renouncing the fruit of actions and freed from the shackles of birth, attain the blissful supreme state.
positive: कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः |जन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम् |
negative: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषाअध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः |द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञैर्-गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत् |

query: When your mind will have fully crossed the more of delusion, you will then grow indifferent to the enjoyments of this world.
positive: यदा ते मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति |तदा गन्तासि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च |
negative: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत् |तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते |

query: Arjuna said: O Keshava, what is the description of a man of steady wisdom, who is established in Samadhi? What does he do at dawn, what in the evening, and what at night? Arjuna said: Krishna, what is the definitionof a God-realized soul, stable to mind and established in Samadhi? How does the man of stable mind speak, how does he sit, how does he walk?
positive: अर्जुन उवाच |स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव |स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम् |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः |अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति |

query: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, when one thoroughly dismisses all cravings of the mind, and is satisfied in the self throughthe self, then he is called stable of mind.
positive: श्रीभगवानुवाच |प्रजहाति यदा कामान्सर्वान्पार्थ मनोगतान् |आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते |ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः |

query: The sage, whose mind remains unperturbed amid sorrows, whose thirst for pleasure has altogether disappeared, and who is free from passion, fear and anger, is called stale of mind.
positive: दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः |वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते |
negative: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन् |इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते |

query: He who is unattached to everything, and meeting with good and evil, neither rejoices nor recoils, his mind is stable.
positive: यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत्तत्प्राप्य शुभाशुभम् |नाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता |
negative: नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना |न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम् |

query: When like a tortoise, which draws in its limbs from all directions, he withdraws his senses from the sense-objects, his mind isstable.
positive: यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः |इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता |
negative: तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः |वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता |

query: Objects of the senses turn away from the abstinent embodied soul; having tasted the sweetness of the sense-objects, he turns away from them.
positive: विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः |रसवर्जं रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते |
negative: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषाअध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः |द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञैर्-गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत् |

query: Having restrained all the senses, he should sit with his mind fixed on Me, devoted and controlling his senses; for the man who has his senses under control, his wisdom is firmly established.
positive: तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः |वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता |
negative: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः |बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव |

query: The man dwelling on sense-objects develops attachment for them; from attachment springs up desire, and from desireensues anger.
positive: ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते |सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते |
negative: प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेनभक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव |भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम् |

query: From anger arises delusion; from delusion, loss of memory; from loss of memory, the destruction of intelligence; and when intelligence is destroyed, one falls down again into the material pool.
positive: क्रोधाद्भवति सम्मोहः सम्मोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः |स्मृतिभ्रंशाद् बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति |
negative: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन् |इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते |

query: But the self-controlled practicant, while enjoying the various sense-objects through his senses, which are disciplined and free from likes and dislikes, attains placidity of mind.
positive: रागद्वेषविमुक्तैस्तु विषयानिन्द्रियैश्चरन् | (or वियुक्तैस्तु)आत्मवश्यैर्विधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति |
negative: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ताच त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः |प्रोच्यते गुणसङ्ख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि |

query: With the attainment of such placidity of mind, all his sorrows come to an end; and the intellect of such a person of tranquil mind, soon withdrawing itself from all sides, becomes firmly established in God.
positive: प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिरस्योपजायते |प्रसन्नचेतसो ह्याशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते |
negative: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः |नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति |

query: He who has not controlled his mind and senses can have no reason; nor can such an undisciplined man think of God. the unthinking man can have no peace; and how That which is night to all beings, in that statethe God-realized Yogi keeps awake. And thatin which all beings keep awake is night to the seer.
positive: नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना |न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम् |
negative: श्रीभगवानुवाच |अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः |स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः |

query: As the wind carries away a boat upon the waters, even so of the senses moving among sense-objects, the one to which the mind is joined takes away his discrimination.
positive: इन्द्रियाणां हि चरतां यन्मनोऽनुविधीयते |तदस्य हरति प्रज्ञां वायुर्नावमिवाम्भसि |
negative: सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद् बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् |वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः |

query: Therefore, Arjuna, he whose senses are restrained in all respects from their objects, his intelligence is firmly established.
positive: तस्माद्यस्य महाबाहो निगृहीतानि सर्वशः |इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता |
negative: तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः |वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता |

query: That which is night to all beings, in that statethe God-realized Yogi keeps awake. And thatin which all beings keep awake is night to the seer.
positive: या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी |यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः |
negative: सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि |ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः |

query: He who has given up all desires, and moves free from attachment, egoism and thirst for enjoyment attains peace.
positive: विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः |निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः स शान्तिमधिगच्छति |
negative: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषाअध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः |द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञैर्-गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत् |

query: Arjuna, such is the state of the God-realized soul; having reached this state, he overcomes delusion. And established in this state, even at the last moment, he attains Brahmic Bliss.
positive: एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति |स्थित्वास्यामन्तकालेऽपि ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृच्छति |
negative: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति |तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा |

query: You are, as it were, puzzling my mind by these seemingly involved expressions; therefore, tell me definitely the one discipline by which I may obtain the highest good.
positive: व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे |तदेकं वद निश्चित्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम् |
negative: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय |निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः |

query: Shree Bhagavan said: Arjuna, in this world there are two kinds of disciplines, as I have explained before: the discipline of the Sankhyas is by knowledge, and the discipline of the Yogis is by action.
positive: श्रीभगवानुवाच |लोकेऽस्मिन् द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ |ज्ञानयोगेन साङ्ख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम् |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च |एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव |

query: Man does not attain freedom from actionwithout entering upon action; nor does he reach perfectionmerely by ceasing to act.
positive: न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते |न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति |
negative: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः |यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते |

query: Surely none can ever remain inactive even for a moment; for everyone helplessly driven to action by nature-born qualities.
positive: न हि कश्चित्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत् |कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः |
negative: प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः |अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् |

query: He who outwardly restraining the organs of sense and action, sits mentally dwelling on the objects of senses, that man of deluded intellect is called a hypocrite.
positive: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन् |इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते |
negative: यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन |कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते |

query: On the other hand, he who controlling the organs of sense and action by the power of his will, and remaining unattached, undertakes the Yoga of Action through those organs, Arjuna, he excels.
positive: यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन |कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते |ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः |

query: Therefore, do you perform your allotted duty, because action is indeed better than inaction; and even the maintenance of your body would not be possible without action.
positive: नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः |शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः |
negative: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च |कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्चितं मतमुत्तमम् |

query: Man is bound by his own action except when it is performed for the sake of sacrifice. Therefore, Arjuna, do you efficiently perform your duty, free from attachment; for the sake of sacrifice alone.
positive: यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः |तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसङ्गः समाचर |
negative: कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि |योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये |

query: Having created mankind together with sacrifices, the Lord of creatures said: By this shall the creatures prosper; let the sacrifice be duly performed. Having created mankind along with the spirit of sacrifice at the beginning of Creation the Creator, Brahma, said to them, “You shall prosper by this; may this yield the enjoyment you seek.”
positive: सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः |अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक् |
negative: ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्म हविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम् |ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना |

query: Foster the gods through this, and let the gods be gracious to you. Each fostering other disinterestedly, you will attain the highest good.
positive: देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः |परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ |
negative: भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम् |उवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान्समवेतान्कुरूनिति |

query: Fostered by sacrifice, the gods will surely bestow on you unasked all the desired enjoyments. He who enjoys the gifts bestowed by them, without giving them in return, is undoubtedly a thief.
positive: इष्टान्भोगान्हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः |तैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः |
negative: श्रीभगवानुवाच |पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते |न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद् दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति |

query: The men who eat the remnants of sacrifices are freed from all sins; but those who cook food only for their own body’s nourishment eat sin.
positive: यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः |भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात् |
negative: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते |पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते |

query: All beings are evolved from food; production of food is dependent on rain; rain ensues from sacrifice.
positive: अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः |यज्ञाद्भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः |
negative: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते |पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते |

query: And sacrifice is rooted in prescribed action. Know that prescribed action has its origin in the Vedas, and the Vedas proceed from the Indestructible; hence the all-pervading supreme imperishable Spirit is always established in sacrifice.
positive: कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम् |तस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम् |
negative: श्रीभगवानुवाच |प्रजहाति यदा कामान्सर्वान्पार्थ मनोगतान् |आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते |

query: Arjuna, he who does not follow the wheel of creation thus set going in this world, sinful and sensual, he lives in vain.
positive: एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः |अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः |अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः |

query: He, however, who takes delight in the self alone and is gratified with the Self, and is contented in the self, has no duty.
positive: यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च मानवः |आत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते |
negative: यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः |समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते |

query: In this world that great soul has no use whatsoever for things done nor for things not done; nor has he selfish dependence of any kind on any creature.
positive: नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन |न चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्चिदर्थव्यपाश्रयः |
negative: न हि कश्चित्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत् |कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः |

query: Therefore, go on efficiently doing your duty without attachment. Doing work without attachment man attains the Supreme.
positive: तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर |असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः |
negative: श्रीभगवानुवाच |अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः |स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः |

query: It is through actionalone that Janaka and otherwise men reached perfection. Having an eye to maintenance of the world order too you should take to action.
positive: कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः |लोकसंग्रहमेवापि सम्पश्यन्कर्तुमर्हसि |
negative: मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः |सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते |

query: For whatever a great man does, that very thing other men also do; whatever standard he sets up; the generality of men follow the same.
positive: यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः |स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते |
negative: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येन केनचित् |अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः |

query: Should I not engage in action, scrupulously at any time, great harm will come to the world; for, Arjuna, men follow My way in all matters.
positive: यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः |मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः |
negative: श्रीभगवानुवाच |बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन |तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप |

query: Arjuna, as the unwise act with attachment, so should the wise man, seeking maintenance of the world order, act without attachment.
positive: सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत |कुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्चिकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम् |
negative: कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि |योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये |

query: A wise man established in the Self, should not unsettle the mind of the ignorant attached to action, but should perform all prescribed duties properly and also make others do the same.
positive: न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम् |जोषयेत्सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान्युक्तः समाचरन् |
negative: कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि |योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये |

query: But, O mighty-armed, the knower of the truth about the division of the modes and the division of actions does not become attached, understanding that the modes are active within the modes.He, however, who has true insight into the respective spheres of Gunasand their actions, holding that it is the Gunasthat move among the Gunas, does not get attached to them, Arjuna.
positive: तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो गुणकर्मविभागयोः |गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च |एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव |

query: Those who are completely deluded by the Gunasof Prakrti remain attached to those Gunas and actions; the man of perfect Knowledge should not unsettle the mind of those insufficiently knowing fools.
positive: प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु |तानकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत् |
negative: ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते |एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् |

query: Therefore, dedicating all actions to Me with your mind fixed on Me, the Self of all freed from hope and the feeling of meum and cured of mental fever, fight.
positive: मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा |निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः |
negative: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः |बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव |

query: Even those men who, with an uncavilling and devout mind, always follow this teaching of Mine are released from the bondage of all actions.
positive: ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः |श्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः |
negative: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः |मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् |

query: They, however, who, finding fault with this teaching of Mine, do not follow it, take those fools to be deluded in the matter of all knowledge, and lost.
positive: ये त्वेतदभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम् |सर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्विद्धि नष्टानचेतसः |
negative: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः |सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च |

query: All living creatures follow their tendencies; even the wise man acts according to the nature he has acquired. What can stubbornness do?
positive: सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि |प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति |
negative: मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम् |हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते |

query: Attraction and repulsion are rooted in all sense-objects. Man should never allow himself to be swayed by them, because they are the two principal enemies standing in the way of his redemption.
positive: इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ |तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ |
negative: वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनमजमव्ययम् |कथं स पुरुषः पार्थ कं घातयति हन्ति कम् |

query: Arjuna said: Now impelled by what, Krishna, does this man commit sin even involuntarily, as though driven by force?
positive: अर्जुन उवाच |अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः |अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः |अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति |

query: As fire is covered by smoke, and a mirror by dust, and the embryo is covered by the womb, so is knowledge covered by desire. As a flame is covered by smoke, mirror by dirt, and embryo by the amnion, so is Knowledge covered by it.
positive: धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथादर्शो मलेन च |यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम् |
negative: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना |करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः |

query: And, Arjuna, Knowledge stand covered by this eternal enemy of the wise, known as desire, which is insatiable like fire.
positive: आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा |कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च |
negative: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते |ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम् |

query: Thus, Arjuna, knowing that which is higher than the intellect and subduing the mind by reason, kill this enemy in the form of Desire that is hard to overcome.
positive: एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना |जहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम् |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम् |त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन |

query: Shree Bhagavan said: I taught this immortal Yoga to Vivasvan; Vivasvan conveyed it to Manu; and Manu imparted it toIksvaku.
positive: श्रीभगवानुवाच |इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम् |विवस्वान्मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत् |
negative: तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् |स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा |

query: Thus transmitted in succession from father to son, Arjuna, this Yoga remained known to the Rajarsis. It has, however, long since disappeared from this earth.
positive: एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः |स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप |
negative: तस्मादज्ञानसम्भूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनात्मनः |छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत |

query: The same ancient Yoga has this day been imparted to you by Me, because you are My devotee and friend; and also because this is a supreme secret.
positive: स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः |भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम् |
negative: श्रीभगवानुवाच |मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः |असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु |

query: Arjuna said: You are of recent origin, while the birth of Vivasvan dates back to remote antiquity. How, then, am I to believe that You taught this Yoga at the beginning of creations?
positive: अर्जुन उवाच |अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः |कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः |अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति |

query: The Blessed Lord said: Many, many births both you and I have passed. I can remember all of them, but you cannot, O subduer of the enemy.
positive: श्रीभगवानुवाच |बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन |तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः |कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति |

query: Arjuna, whenever righteousness is on the decline, and unrighteousness is in the ascendant, then I body Myself forth.
positive: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत |अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् |यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम |

query: For the protection of the virtuous, for the extirpation of evil-doers, and for establishing Dharmaon a firm footing, I born from age to age.
positive: परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम् |धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे |
negative: मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी |विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि |

query: Arjuna, My birth and activities are divine. he who knows this in reality is not reborn on leaving his body, but comes to Me.
positive: जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः |त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन |
negative: अर्जुन उवाच |मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् |यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम |

query: Completely rid of passion, fear and anger, wholly absorbed in me, depending on me, and purified by the penance of wisdom, many have become one with me even in the past.
positive: वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः |बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः |
negative: ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते |एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् |

query: In this world, the gods are eager for the success of works; indeed, in the human world, success is born of works. In this world of human beings; men seeking the fruition of their activities worship the gods; for success born of actions follow quickly.
positive: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः |क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा |
negative: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते |पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते |

query: The four orders of societywere created by Me classifying them according to the mode of Prakrti predominant in each and apportioning corresponding duties to them;
positive: चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः |तस्य कर्तारमपि मां विद्ध्यकर्तारमव्ययम् |
negative: प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु |तानकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत् |

query: Since I have no craving for the fruit of actions; actions do not contaminate Me, Even he who thus knows Me in reality is not bound by actions.
positive: न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा |इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते |
negative: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः |सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च |

query: Having known thus, action was performed even by the ancient seekers for liberation; therefore do thou also perform action, as did the ancients in days of yore.
positive: एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः |कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम् |
negative: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते |कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते |

query: What is action and what is inaction? Even men of intelligence are puzzled over this question. Therefore, I shall expound to you the truth about action, knowing which you will be freed from its evil effect.
positive: किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः |तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् |
negative: ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते |सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते |

query: The truth about action must be known and the truth of inaction also must be known; even so the truth about prohibited action must be known. For mysterious are the ways of action.
positive: कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः |अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः |
negative: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ |ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि |

query: He who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is a yogi, who has performed all action.
positive: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः |स बुद्धिमान्मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत् |
negative: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय |सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते |

query: Even the wise call him a sage, whose undertaking are all free from desire and thoughts of the world, and whose actions are burnt up by the fire of wisdom.
positive: यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः |ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः |
negative: कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः |जन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम् |

query: Having subdued his mind and body, and given up all objects of enjoyment, and free from craving; he who performs sheer bodily actions, does not incur sin.
positive: निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः |शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् |
negative: नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः |शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः |
